--[[
	Rocks/PDataBuilder: per-burst pData construction and chunk rolls, shared by Emit, Animate and the
	AnimateLoop refresh. rollChunks resets every rig slot (parked ones too) so no state survives a
	pooled prior life: rolled Sizes/CFrames go to the anchored parts, spawn poses and launch velocities
	land in rig buffers as trajectory seeds (Rocks/init.luau buildTrajectories).
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Range)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.Parent.PartConstants)

local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors
local FAR_CFRAME = CFrame.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)

local PDataBuilder = {}

local function rollRange(r)
	return RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(r)
end

-- EvenDistribution: chunk i of n samples a deterministic spread across the range.
local function rollAxis(r, even, i, n)
	if even and n > 0 then
		return r.Min + (r.Max - r.Min) * ((i - 0.5) / n)
	end
	return RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(r)
end

-- Random unit vector.
local function randomAxis()
	local v = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1)
	if v.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return Vector3.yAxis end
	return v.Unit
end

-- Launch direction for chunk i of n in the emitter frame, returned in WORLD space. Directional:
-- EmissionDirection +- SpreadAngle. Ring: even azimuth around the EmissionDirection axis, elevated
-- by SpreadAngle.X degrees.
local function launchDir(data, originCF, i, n)
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
	local axis = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	if data.BurstMode == "Ring" then
		local u = axis:Cross(Vector3.xAxis)
		if u.Magnitude < 0.01 then u = axis:Cross(Vector3.zAxis) end
		u = u.Unit
		local v = axis:Cross(u)
		local az = ((i - 0.5) / n) * 2 * math.pi + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2
		local elev = math.rad(data.SpreadAngle.X)
		local dirLocal = (u * math.cos(az) + v * math.sin(az)) * math.cos(elev) + axis * math.sin(elev)
		return originCF.Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(dirLocal)
	end
	local spread = data.SpreadAngle or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, axis)
	if spread.X > 0 or spread.Y > 0 then
		cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(
			math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.X),
			math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.Y), 0)
	end
	return originCF.Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(cf.LookVector)
end

-- Rolls and resets every chunk slot from the origin pose. Slots past the rolled count park at
-- FAR_CFRAME so pooled leftovers never show.
function PDataBuilder.rollChunks(pData, data, rig, originCF)
	local rtSize = (data.RenderTemplate and data.RenderTemplate:IsA("BasePart")) and data.RenderTemplate.Size or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local count = math.clamp(math.floor(rollRange(data.ChunkCount) + 0.5), 1, rig.chunkCap)
	pData._chunkCount = count
	local scale0 = data.Scale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Scale, pData.Seeds.Scale) or 1
	pData._curScale = scale0
	for i = 1, rig.chunkCap do
		local chunk = rig.parts[i]
		if i <= count then
			local px = rollAxis(data.PosX, data.PosXEven, i, count)
			local py = rollAxis(data.PosY, data.PosYEven, i, count)
			local pz = rollAxis(data.PosZ, data.PosZEven, i, count)
			local pos
			if data.PosMode == "Global" then
				pos = originCF.Position + Vector3.new(px, py, pz)
			else
				pos = (originCF * CFrame.new(px, py, pz)).Position
			end
			rig.baseSize[i] = rtSize * rollRange(data.ChunkScale)
			rig.halfExt[i] = rig.baseSize[i] * 0.5
			-- Per-chunk launch speed: envelope seed gives spawn-time variation.
			local speed = data.Speed and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Speed, GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed)) or 0
			local launchV = launchDir(data, originCF, i, count) * speed
			local axis = randomAxis()
			local tumble = math.rad(rollRange(data.TumbleSpeed)) * (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1)
			local rot = CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6.283, math.random() * 6.283, math.random() * 6.283)
			-- Trajectory seeds (Rocks/init.luau builds the full path from these at emit).
			rig.launchVel[i] = launchV
			rig.launchAng[i] = axis * tumble
			rig.spawnPos[i] = pos
			rig.spawnRot[i] = rot
			rig.trajs[i] = nil
			rig.bounciness[i] = math.clamp(rollRange(data.Bounciness), 0, 1)
			rig.gravity[i] = rollRange(data.Gravity)
			rig.friction[i] = math.clamp(rollRange(data.Friction), 0, 1)
			rig.touched[i] = false
			rig.writeCFs[i] = rot + pos
			pcall(function()
				chunk.Size = rig.baseSize[i] * math.max(scale0, 0.01)
				chunk.CFrame = rot + pos
			end)
		else
			pcall(function()
				chunk.Anchored = true
				chunk.CanCollide = false
				chunk.CanTouch = false
				chunk.CFrame = FAR_CFRAME
			end)
			rig.launchVel[i] = Vector3.zero
			rig.launchAng[i] = Vector3.zero
			rig.spawnPos[i] = FAR_CFRAME.Position
			rig.spawnRot[i] = CFrame.identity
			rig.trajs[i] = nil
			rig.touched[i] = false
			rig.writeCFs[i] = FAR_CFRAME
		end
	end
end

-- A nested burst's origin: the emitted parent clone, at the burst's own place on it when a
-- Container or a Matte carries it (pData._parentOffset). nil once the clone is gone.
-- Cross-file: Rocks/init reads it again for every cycle of an Animate burst.
function PDataBuilder.cloneOrigin(pData, link)
	if not (link and link.Parent) then
		return nil
	end
	local originCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
	if pData._parentOffset then
		originCF = originCF * pData._parentOffset
	end
	return originCF
end

function PDataBuilder.build(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx, link)
	local seeds = {
		Scale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Scale),
		Brightness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Brightness),
		Transparency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Transparency),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	local pData = {
		Type = "Rocks",
		VisualPart = model,
		_rig = rig,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = lifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		_sourceItem = item,
		Graphs = {
			Scale = data.Scale,
			Brightness = data.Brightness,
			Transparency = data.Transparency,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
			Color = data.Color,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, lifeTime),
		_sinkOut = data.SinkOut ~= false,
		_inheritFloor = data.InheritFloor == true,
		_hitPerChunk = data.HitPerChunk == true,
		_hitFired = false,
		-- OnHit fires from the precomputed first impact (Rocks/init.luau); Events.afterUpdate's raycast and
		-- Collision actions must skip this pData.
		_ownsOnHit = true,
		-- Carried by a Container or a Matte: its place on the parent clone (NestedEmit.keepPlace).
		_parentOffset = emitCtx and emitCtx._rigPlace or nil,
		-- Carried by a Container: its record, for its Transparency (Container/Fade).
		_drive = emitCtx and emitCtx._containerDrive or nil,
	}

	-- Origin: event override, then live parent clone (nested emit), then source pose. Sampled once at
	-- emit; chunks fly in world space and never track the source.
	local originCF
	if emitCtx then
		local oCF
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then oCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		oCF = oCF or emitCtx.EventOriginCF
		if oCF then
			originCF = (emitCtx.UseFullOrigin and oCF) or CFrame.new(oCF.Position) * item.CFrame.Rotation
		end
	end
	if not originCF then
		originCF = PDataBuilder.cloneOrigin(pData, link)
	end
	-- The rig Model has no PrimaryPart, so an unset WorldPivot tracks the live bbox, which the parked
	-- slots drag away; stamp the burst origin so nested links read it.
	pcall(function() model.WorldPivot = originCF or item.CFrame end)
	PDataBuilder.rollChunks(pData, data, rig, originCF or item.CFrame)
	return pData
end

return PDataBuilder

--[[
	Rocks/Trajectory  -  debris paths worked out whole at emit: arcs raycast in slices to find each
	impact, bounces reflected (restitution above BOUNCE_MIN, friction on the tangent), a closed-form
	roll-out and an exact rest pose. evaluate(traj, t) is a pure function of time, so playback never
	jitters and reversed or scaled time replays exactly. The raycast is injected
	(raycastFn(origin, displacement)) so it runs headless.
]]

-- Bounces slower than this along the normal don't rebound; the path rolls out.
local BOUNCE_MIN = 6
local MAX_BOUNCES = 3
-- Roll-out deceleration = friction x gravity x this (rolling resistance).
local ROLL_RESIST = 0.5
-- Arc raycast slicing.
local FIRST_ARC_SLICES = 6
local BOUNCE_ARC_SLICES = 4
local MAX_ARC_TIME = 6
-- rules.offWalls: a piece meeting a steep surface is sent off at least this fast, at most this many
-- times, before it may rest against one.
local WALL_PUSH = 4
local MAX_WALL_HITS = 4
-- rules.airTime: past an arc's own window the arc is searched on in slices this long.
local SEEK_SLICE = 0.5
-- rules.offEdges: a step down shallower than this still carries a roll; the edge is found to within
-- EDGE_STEP in EDGE_STEPS halvings; a path falls off an edge at most MAX_EDGE_DROPS times.
local EDGE_DROP = 0.5
local EDGE_STEP = 0.1
local EDGE_STEPS = 8
local MAX_EDGE_DROPS = 2

local Trajectory = {}

-- How far a box reaches along dir (its scaled half extents projected).
local function support(rot, halfExt, dir, scale)
	return (math.abs(rot.XVector:Dot(dir)) * halfExt.X
		+ math.abs(rot.YVector:Dot(dir)) * halfExt.Y
		+ math.abs(rot.ZVector:Dot(dir)) * halfExt.Z) * scale
end

local function spinCF(rot, w, dt)
	local mag = w.Magnitude
	if mag * dt < 1e-4 then return rot end
	return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(w * (1 / mag), mag * dt) * rot
end

-- The exact time the centre's parabola crosses the contact plane, so evaluate() stays continuous
-- through an impact. closing: only a crossing made against the normal counts (a piece starting
-- on or in the surface crosses it upward first).
local function planeCrossTime(p, v, gVec, n, target, tMax, closing)
	local a = 0.5 * gVec:Dot(n)
	local b = v:Dot(n)
	local c = p:Dot(n) - target
	if math.abs(a) < 1e-6 then
		if math.abs(b) < 1e-9 then return nil end
		if closing and b > 0 then return nil end
		local t = -c / b
		if t >= 0 and t <= tMax then return t end
		return nil
	end
	local disc = b * b - 4 * a * c
	if disc < 0 then return nil end
	local sq = math.sqrt(disc)
	if closing then
		-- The root with a negative slope, whichever way gravity lies to the normal.
		local t = (-b - sq) / (2 * a)
		if t >= 0 and t <= tMax then return t end
		return nil
	end
	local t1 = (-b - sq) / (2 * a)
	local t2 = (-b + sq) / (2 * a)
	if t1 > t2 then
		t1, t2 = t2, t1
	end
	if t1 >= 0 and t1 <= tMax then return t1 end
	if t2 >= 0 and t2 <= tMax then return t2 end
	return nil
end

-- Lies flat on normal n, heading kept. Weighted by 1/halfExt, so debris settles on its broad face.
-- Returns the rotation and the resting face's half extent.
local function restPose(rot, halfExt, n)
	local dx, dy, dz = rot.XVector:Dot(n), rot.YVector:Dot(n), rot.ZVector:Dot(n)
	local sx = math.abs(dx) / math.max(halfExt.X, 0.05)
	local sy = math.abs(dy) / math.max(halfExt.Y, 0.05)
	local sz = math.abs(dz) / math.max(halfExt.Z, 0.05)
	local axisVec, faceHalf
	if sx >= sy and sx >= sz then
		axisVec = rot.XVector * (dx >= 0 and 1 or -1)
		faceHalf = halfExt.X
	elseif sy >= sz then
		axisVec = rot.YVector * (dy >= 0 and 1 or -1)
		faceHalf = halfExt.Y
	else
		axisVec = rot.ZVector * (dz >= 0 and 1 or -1)
		faceHalf = halfExt.Z
	end
	local d = math.clamp(axisVec:Dot(n), -1, 1)
	local arc = axisVec:Cross(n)
	if arc.Magnitude > 1e-5 and d < 0.9999 then
		return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(arc.Unit, math.acos(d)) * rot, faceHalf
	end
	return rot, faceHalf
end

-- rules.offEdges: where along a roll-out (its eased share) the centre first stands over nothing,
-- or nil when it ends carried; the end is asked first.
local function edgeOf(roll, n, d, raycastFn)
	local function carried(share)
		local centre = roll.p0:Lerp(roll.p1, share)
		local height = centre:Dot(n) - d
		return raycastFn(centre, n * -(height + EDGE_DROP)) ~= nil
	end
	if carried(1) then
		return nil
	end
	local length = (roll.p1 - roll.p0).Magnitude
	local low, high = 0, 1
	for _ = 1, EDGE_STEPS do
		if (high - low) * length < EDGE_STEP then
			break
		end
		local middle = (low + high) / 2
		if carried(middle) then
			low = middle
		else
			high = middle
		end
	end
	return high
end

-- rules.offEdges: a roll cut at `edge`: the time, pose, speed and spin it flies on with. The roll
-- eases as 1 - (1 - s)^2.
local function overEdge(roll, edge, n, sup)
	local s = 1 - math.sqrt(1 - edge)
	local velocity = (roll.p1 - roll.p0) * (2 * (1 - s) / roll.dur)
	local axis = n:Cross(velocity)
	local spin = Vector3.zero
	if axis.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
		spin = axis.Unit * (velocity.Magnitude / math.max(sup, 0.1))
	end
	return roll.t0 + roll.dur * s, roll.p0:Lerp(roll.p1, edge), velocity, roll.rot0:Lerp(roll.rotF, edge), spin
end

-- rules.airTime: looks on along an arc for ground past its window, from `from` to `to` seconds; the
-- hit and the time the centre is seated on it.
local function seekGround(p, v, gVec, rot, w, halfExt, scale, raycastFn, from, to)
	local prevT = from
	local prevP = p + v * from + gVec * (0.5 * from * from)
	while prevT < to do
		local nextT = math.min(prevT + SEEK_SLICE, to)
		local nextP = p + v * nextT + gVec * (0.5 * nextT * nextT)
		local seg = nextP - prevP
		if seg.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
			local dirU = seg.Unit
			local reach = support(rot, halfExt, dirU, scale)
			local h = raycastFn(prevP, seg + dirU * reach)
			if h then
				local frac = math.clamp((h.Position - prevP).Magnitude / (seg.Magnitude + reach), 0, 1)
				local approxT = prevT + (nextT - prevT) * frac
				local supEst = support(spinCF(rot, w, approxT), halfExt, h.Normal, scale)
				local target = h.Position:Dot(h.Normal) + supEst
				return h, planeCrossTime(p, v, gVec, h.Normal, target, to, true) or approxT
			end
		end
		prevT = nextT
		prevP = nextP
	end
	return nil, nil
end

-- What an unbuilt chunk flies until its full path is built (Rocks/init spreads builds over frames).
function Trajectory.ballistic(p0, v0, rot0, w0)
	return { segs = { { kind = 1, t0 = 0, p0 = p0, v0 = v0, rot0 = rot0, w = w0 } }, impactT = nil, hit = nil, restT = math.huge }
end

-- A slide: `dur` seconds of constant acceleration, the rotation kept; `settle` is a fall made over
-- the first settleTime seconds. Reactor/Slash leads a cut piece's path with one.
function Trajectory.slide(p0, v0, rot0, accel, dur, settle, settleTime)
	return { kind = 4, t0 = 0, p0 = p0, v0 = v0, rot0 = rot0, accel = accel, dur = dur, settle = settle, settleTime = settleTime }
end

-- `traj` led by a slide: its times moved on by the lead's length; the lead kept as traj.lead.
function Trajectory.led(lead, traj)
	local segs = { lead }
	for _, seg in ipairs(traj.segs) do
		seg.t0 += lead.dur
		table.insert(segs, seg)
	end
	traj.segs = segs
	if traj.impactT then
		traj.impactT += lead.dur
	end
	traj.restT += lead.dur
	traj.lead = lead
	return traj
end

-- A path that only lies at `cf` on a surface facing `normal` (Reactor/Recarve).
function Trajectory.lying(cf, normal)
	return { segs = { { kind = 3, t0 = 0, cf = cf } }, impactT = nil, hit = nil, restT = 0, restNormal = normal }
end

-- A path that only settles: the lead, then at rest where it ends.
function Trajectory.settled(lead, normal)
	local finish = lead.p0 + lead.v0 * lead.dur + lead.accel * (0.5 * lead.dur * lead.dur)
	if lead.settle then
		finish += lead.settle
	end
	return { segs = { lead, { kind = 3, t0 = lead.dur, cf = lead.rot0 + finish } }, impactT = nil, hit = nil, restT = lead.dur, restNormal = normal, lead = lead }
end

-- One chunk's whole path: { segs (kind 1 ballistic, 2 roll, 3 rest, 4 slide), impactT, hit,
-- restT, restNormal }. rules (Reactor/Play's; Rocks pass none): offWalls (bounces off walls),
-- fromRest (may start on or in the surface), airTime (seconds ground is looked for; without it an
-- arc is searched in its own window only), offEdges (a roll falls off edges).
function Trajectory.build(p0, v0, rot0, w0, halfExt, scale, gravity, bounciness, friction, raycastFn, rules)
	local offWalls = rules ~= nil and rules.offWalls == true
	local offEdges = rules ~= nil and rules.offEdges == true
	local fromRest = rules ~= nil and rules.fromRest == true
	local airTime = rules ~= nil and rules.airTime or nil
	local segs = {}
	local traj = { segs = segs, impactT = nil, hit = nil, restT = math.huge }
	local t, p, v, rot, w = 0, p0, v0, rot0, w0
	local gVec = Vector3.new(0, -gravity, 0)

	local bounce = 0
	local wallHits = 0
	local edgeDrops = 0
	while bounce <= MAX_BOUNCES do
		-- Raycast the arc in slices until it hits or the window closes.
		local slices = bounce == 0 and FIRST_ARC_SLICES or BOUNCE_ARC_SLICES
		-- Time enough for the parabola to come back down.
		local upTime = math.max(v.Y, 0) / math.max(gravity, 1)
		local window = math.min(upTime * 2 + 1.5, MAX_ARC_TIME)
		local sliceDt = window / slices
		local hit, hitT = nil, nil
		local prevP = p
		for s = 1, slices do
			local st = s * sliceDt
			local sp = p + v * st + gVec * (0.5 * st * st)
			local seg = sp - prevP
			if seg.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
				local dirU = seg.Unit
				local reach = support(rot, halfExt, dirU, scale)
				local h = raycastFn(prevP, seg + dirU * reach)
				if h then
					hit = h
					-- The extent toward the surface at the estimated pose.
					local frac = math.clamp((h.Position - prevP).Magnitude / (seg.Magnitude + reach), 0, 1)
					local approxT = (s - 1) * sliceDt + sliceDt * frac
					local supEst = support(spinCF(rot, w, approxT), halfExt, h.Normal, scale)
					-- The exact crossing, seated at support height.
					local target = h.Position:Dot(h.Normal) + supEst
					hitT = planeCrossTime(p, v, gVec, h.Normal, target, window, fromRest) or approxT
					break
				end
			end
			prevP = sp
		end

		if not hit and airTime and airTime - t > window then
			hit, hitT = seekGround(p, v, gVec, rot, w, halfExt, scale, raycastFn, window, airTime - t)
		end

		if not hit then
			-- No ground in the window: ballistic to the end.
			segs[#segs + 1] = { kind = 1, t0 = t, p0 = p, v0 = v, rot0 = rot, w = w }
			return traj
		end

		local n = hit.Normal
		local vImp = v + gVec * hitT
		local rotImp = spinCF(rot, w, hitT)
		local sup = support(rotImp, halfExt, n, scale)
		-- On the parabola, so the boundary never snaps.
		local pImp = p + v * hitT + gVec * (0.5 * hitT * hitT)

		segs[#segs + 1] = { kind = 1, t0 = t, p0 = p, v0 = v, rot0 = rot, w = w }
		t += hitT
		if not traj.impactT then
			traj.impactT = t
			traj.hit = hit
		end

		local vn = vImp:Dot(n)
		local vt = vImp - n * vn
		-- Bounces only when the rebound clears the threshold.
		if offWalls and n.Y <= 0.3 and wallHits < MAX_WALL_HITS then
			-- A wall is not a floor bounce: the piece still lands.
			wallHits += 1
			v = vt * (1 - friction) + n * math.max(-vn * bounciness, WALL_PUSH)
			p = pImp
			rot = rotImp
		elseif (-vn * bounciness) > BOUNCE_MIN and n.Y > 0.3 and bounce < MAX_BOUNCES then
			bounce += 1
			-- Restitution, impact friction, travel into tumble.
			v = vt * (1 - friction) + n * (-vn * bounciness)
			local axis = n:Cross(vt)
			if axis.Magnitude > 1e-4 and vt.Magnitude > 0.5 then
				w = axis.Unit * (vt.Magnitude / math.max(sup, 0.1))
			end
			p = pImp
			rot = rotImp
		else
			-- Roll-out: closed-form deceleration, the rotation blending to the rest pose in step.
			local speed = vt.Magnitude
			local decel = math.max(friction * gravity * ROLL_RESIST, 10)
			local dur = math.min(speed / decel, 2)
			local dir = speed > 1e-3 and vt.Unit or Vector3.xAxis
			local rotF, faceHalf = restPose(rotImp, halfExt, n)
			local d = hit.Position:Dot(n)
			-- The rest centre at face height on the plane.
			local function planeSeat(pt, height)
				return pt + n * ((d + height) - pt:Dot(n))
			end
			local rollP0 = planeSeat(pImp, sup)
			local rollP1 = planeSeat(rollP0 + dir * (speed * dur - 0.5 * decel * dur * dur), faceHalf * scale)
			local roll = { kind = 2, t0 = t, dur = math.max(dur, 0.15), p0 = rollP0, p1 = rollP1, rot0 = rotImp, rotF = rotF }
			segs[#segs + 1] = roll
			local edge = offEdges and edgeDrops < MAX_EDGE_DROPS and edgeOf(roll, n, d, raycastFn)
			if not edge then
				t += roll.dur
				segs[#segs + 1] = { kind = 3, t0 = t, cf = rotF + rollP1 }
				traj.restT = t
				traj.restNormal = n
				return traj
			end
			edgeDrops += 1
			t, p, v, rot, w = overEdge(roll, edge, n, sup)
		end
	end
	return traj
end

-- The pose at time t (any t).
function Trajectory.evaluate(traj, t, gravity)
	local segs = traj.segs
	local seg = segs[1]
	for s = 2, #segs do
		if segs[s].t0 <= t then seg = segs[s] else break end
	end
	if seg.kind == 1 then
		local dt = math.max(t - seg.t0, 0)
		local p = seg.p0 + seg.v0 * dt + Vector3.new(0, -0.5 * gravity * dt * dt, 0)
		return spinCF(seg.rot0, seg.w, dt) + p
	elseif seg.kind == 2 then
		local s = math.clamp((t - seg.t0) / seg.dur, 0, 1)
		local e = 1 - (1 - s) * (1 - s)
		return seg.rot0:Lerp(seg.rotF, e) + seg.p0:Lerp(seg.p1, e)
	elseif seg.kind == 4 then
		local dt = math.clamp(t - seg.t0, 0, seg.dur)
		local p = seg.p0 + seg.v0 * dt + seg.accel * (0.5 * dt * dt)
		if seg.settle then
			local share = math.min(dt / seg.settleTime, 1)
			p += seg.settle * (share * share)
		end
		return seg.rot0 + p
	end
	return seg.cf
end

-- Velocity and spin at t, for a path cut short and rebuilt (Reactor/Play). The segment search
-- repeats evaluate's, which runs per chunk per frame.
function Trajectory.velocity(traj, t, gravity)
	local segs = traj.segs
	local seg = segs[1]
	for s = 2, #segs do
		if segs[s].t0 <= t then seg = segs[s] else break end
	end
	if seg.kind == 1 then
		local dt = math.max(t - seg.t0, 0)
		return seg.v0 + Vector3.new(0, -gravity * dt, 0), seg.w
	elseif seg.kind == 2 then
		local s = math.clamp((t - seg.t0) / seg.dur, 0, 1)
		return (seg.p1 - seg.p0) * (2 * (1 - s) / seg.dur), Vector3.zero
	elseif seg.kind == 4 then
		local dt = math.clamp(t - seg.t0, 0, seg.dur)
		return seg.v0 + seg.accel * dt, Vector3.zero
	end
	return Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
end

return Trajectory

--[[
	RollLock  -  a native ParticleEmitter's Lock Roll (attribute LockRoll, with Orientation
	VelocityPerpendicular). Roblox turns such a particle so its image's top is world up flattened onto
	its plane (world -Z facing straight up, +Z straight down), never reading the parent's turn. With
	Lock Roll the image turns with the parent: a burst is emitted by helper copies of the emitter, one
	per spread direction, each with its Rotation corrected. Copies, since an emitter spawns all of a
	frame's particles with the direction it has when the engine steps.
	  RollLock.applies(emitter), RollLock.emit(emitter, count)
	  RollLock.engineTop(normal), RollLock.correction(frame, localDirection) -> degrees
	  RollLock.tilt(localDirection, spreadDegrees, random) -> CFrame (no twist)
	  RollLock.trackSpin(pData), RollLock.spinOf(pData) -> degrees a second (Follow Spin)
	  RollLock.step(dt), RollLock.reset(), RollLock.pools() (offline test)
	Helpers live in the runtime folder; an attachment's hang on a holder part shared by its Lock Roll
	emitters, a part's are parts of its size. A change to a COPIED property reaches every helper at
	once. Only what Particles.fireEmitter fires is reached, not an Enabled emitter. Helpers and holders
	are given back and reused; what stays unused IDLE_SECONDS goes.
	Follow Spin (FollowSpin): each burst gets RotSpeed plus the spin of the nearest spinning copy above
	the emitter about the burst's direction, at the burst.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)
local InstanceMap = require(script.Parent.InstanceMap)
local PartConstants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)

local RollLock = {}

-- Directions in one burst at most; a bigger burst shares them.
local MOST_DIRECTIONS = 12
-- Helpers an emitter may hold: two bursts in one frame still find helpers not yet aimed.
local MOST_HELPERS = MOST_DIRECTIONS * 2
-- A pool is given back this long after its last particle died; a kept holder or helper goes after
-- as long unused.
local IDLE_SECONDS = 5
-- A holder's side in studs (a number, so loading touches no Vector3).
local HOLDER_SIDE = 0.05
-- Below this, world up has no direction left in the plane.
local FLAT = 1e-4
-- RotSpeed turns the image the same way round its normal as the parent, against Rotation's sense.
local SPIN_SIGN = 1
-- The share of a life an angle graph's slope is read over, either side of now.
local SLOPE_SPAN = 0.01
-- Copied from the emitter. Rotation, SpreadAngle, Rate and Enabled are the helper's own.
local COPIED = {
	"Acceleration", "Brightness", "Color", "Drag", "EmissionDirection", "FlipbookFramerate",
	"FlipbookLayout", "FlipbookMode", "FlipbookStartRandom", "FlipbookSizeX", "FlipbookSizeY",
	"Lifetime", "LightEmission", "LightInfluence", "LockedToPart", "Orientation", "RotSpeed",
	"Shape", "ShapeInOut", "ShapePartial", "ShapeStyle", "Size", "Speed", "Squash", "Texture",
	"TimeScale", "Transparency", "VelocityInheritance", "WindAffectsDrag", "ZOffset",
}
local IS_COPIED = {}
for _, property in ipairs(COPIED) do
	IS_COPIED[property] = true
end

local pools = {}
-- holders[attachment] = { part, parent, users, spare, followed }, shared by its emitters.
local holders = {}
-- Holders no emitter stands on and part helpers none uses, kept for the next copies.
local keptHolders = {}
local keptParts = {}
-- Seconds of Heartbeat so far, to age kept holders and helpers.
local clock = 0
-- Copies that turn by a play's RotSpeed -> that play; an ended play (_reclaimed) lends none.
local spinning = InstanceMap.new()
local frameNumber = 0
local heartbeat = nil
-- Made on the first spread.
local random = nil

function RollLock.engineTop(normal)
	local top = Vector3.yAxis - normal * normal.Y
	if top.Magnitude < FLAT then
		-- Facing straight up: world -Z; straight down: world +Z.
		if normal.Y > 0 then
			return -Vector3.zAxis
		end
		return Vector3.zAxis
	end
	return top.Unit
end

function RollLock.correction(frame, localDirection)
	local normal = frame:VectorToWorldSpace(localDirection)
	local shown = RollLock.engineTop(normal)
	-- On an unturned parent the top is Roblox's own; the parent's frame carries it.
	local wanted = frame:VectorToWorldSpace(RollLock.engineTop(localDirection))
	-- Rotation turns the image the other way round the normal.
	return -math.deg(math.atan2(normal:Dot(shown:Cross(wanted)), shown:Dot(wanted)))
end

-- The two axes SpreadAngle's X and Y turn `localDirection` about.
local function spreadAxes(localDirection)
	if math.abs(localDirection.Y) > 0.5 then
		return Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.zAxis
	elseif math.abs(localDirection.Z) > 0.5 then
		return Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis
	end
	return Vector3.zAxis, Vector3.yAxis
end

function RollLock.tilt(localDirection, spreadDegrees, rng)
	local first, second = spreadAxes(localDirection)
	local turned = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(first, math.rad(rng:NextNumber(-spreadDegrees.X, spreadDegrees.X)))
		* CFrame.fromAxisAngle(second, math.rad(rng:NextNumber(-spreadDegrees.Y, spreadDegrees.Y)))
	local direction = turned:VectorToWorldSpace(localDirection)
	-- The shortest turn onto that direction: no twist about it, so the image keeps its roll.
	local axis = localDirection:Cross(direction)
	if axis.Magnitude < FLAT then
		return CFrame.identity
	end
	return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, math.acos(math.clamp(localDirection:Dot(direction), -1, 1)))
end

-- The parent's frame as every link is read (a Bone's animated pose).
local function parentFrame(emitter)
	return PartConstants.resolveLinkCFrame(emitter.Parent)
end

-- A graph that never changes is kept as a value (StaticPass).
local STATIC_KEYS = { RotSpeedX = "_staticRotSpeedX", RotSpeedY = "_staticRotSpeedY", RotSpeedZ = "_staticRotSpeedZ" }

function RollLock.trackSpin(pData)
	local graphs = pData.Graphs
	if not pData.VisualPart or not graphs then
		return
	end
	for key, staticKey in pairs(STATIC_KEYS) do
		-- A speed kept as a value turns only when it is not 0.
		if graphs[key] or (pData[staticKey] or 0) ~= 0 then
			spinning:set(pData.VisualPart, pData)
			return
		end
	end
end

function RollLock.spinOf(pData)
	local graphs, seeds = pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds
	local life = math.max(pData.LifeTime or 1, 1e-3)
	local at = math.clamp((pData._effectiveElapsed or 0) / life, 0, 1)
	local timescale = 1
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil then
		timescale = pData._tsOverride
	elseif graphs.Timescale then
		timescale = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(at, graphs.Timescale, seeds.Timescale)
	end
	local function rate(key)
		local graph = graphs[key]
		if not graph then
			-- An unchanging value: a speed in Speed mode, a still angle otherwise.
			if pData.RotMode == "Speed" then
				return pData[STATIC_KEYS[key]] or 0
			end
			return 0
		end
		if pData.RotMode == "Speed" then
			return GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(at, graph, seeds[key])
		end
		local before = math.max(at - SLOPE_SPAN, 0)
		local after = math.min(at + SLOPE_SPAN, 1)
		local turned = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(after, graph, seeds[key]) - GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(before, graph, seeds[key])
		return turned / ((after - before) * life)
	end
	return Vector3.new(rate("RotSpeedX"), rate("RotSpeedY"), rate("RotSpeedZ")) * timescale
end

-- Degrees a second the nearest spinning copy above the emitter turns about `normal` now.
local function spinAbout(emitter, normal)
	local node = emitter.Parent
	while node do
		local play = spinning:get(node)
		if play and not play._reclaimed and play.VisualPart == node then
			local frame = PartConstants.resolveLinkCFrame(node)
			return frame:VectorToWorldSpace(RollLock.spinOf(play)):Dot(normal)
		end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return 0
end

function RollLock.applies(emitter)
	if emitter:GetAttribute("LockRoll") ~= true then
		return false
	end
	if emitter.Orientation ~= Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular then
		return false
	end
	local parent = emitter.Parent
	return parent ~= nil and (parent:IsA("Attachment") or parent:IsA("BasePart"))
end

local function copyInto(source, helperEmitter)
	for _, property in ipairs(COPIED) do
		helperEmitter[property] = source[property]
	end
end

-- The first kept entry whose part is still in the runtime folder, the latest kept first.
local function takeKept(list, partKey)
	while #list > 0 do
		local entry = table.remove(list)
		if entry[partKey].Parent ~= nil then
			return entry
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- The attachment's holder: the one its other emitters stand on, a kept one, or a new one.
local function claimHolder(parent)
	local holder = holders[parent]
	if holder and holder.part.Parent == nil then
		holders[parent] = nil
		holder = nil
	end
	if not holder then
		local frame = PartConstants.resolveLinkCFrame(parent)
		holder = takeKept(keptHolders, "part")
		if holder then
			holder.part.CFrame = frame
		else
			local size = Vector3.new(HOLDER_SIDE, HOLDER_SIDE, HOLDER_SIDE)
			holder = { part = VisualHost.newCarrier("RollLock", size, frame, VisualHost.getFolder()), users = 0, spare = {}, followed = -1 }
		end
		holder.parent = parent
		holders[parent] = holder
	end
	holder.users += 1
	return holder
end

local function releaseHolder(holder)
	holder.users -= 1
	if holder.users > 0 then
		return
	end
	if holders[holder.parent] == holder then
		holders[holder.parent] = nil
	end
	holder.parent = nil
	if holder.part.Parent ~= nil then
		holder.keptAt = clock
		table.insert(keptHolders, holder)
	end
end

-- A helper given back with its particles cleared, as the emitter's own go when it leaves.
local function giveBack(helper, list)
	helper.emitter:Clear()
	helper.lifeLeft = 0
	helper.usedFrame = -1
	helper.spun = false
	helper.keptAt = clock
	if helper.host.Parent ~= nil then
		table.insert(list, helper)
	end
end

local function releasePool(emitter, pool)
	for _, connection in ipairs(pool.connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	-- An attachment's helpers stay on its holder for the next emitter there; a part's are kept.
	local spare = pool.holder and pool.holder.spare or keptParts
	for _, helper in ipairs(pool.helpers) do
		giveBack(helper, spare)
	end
	if pool.holder then
		releaseHolder(pool.holder)
	end
	pools[emitter] = nil
end

-- An emitter moved to another attachment: its helpers, particles and all, go to that one's holder.
local function moveTo(pool, parent)
	local holder = claimHolder(parent)
	for _, helper in ipairs(pool.helpers) do
		helper.host.Parent = holder.part
	end
	releaseHolder(pool.holder)
	pool.holder = holder
	pool.parent = parent
end

-- Kept entries unused IDLE_SECONDS go (swap-and-pop).
local function retire(list, partKey)
	for index = #list, 1, -1 do
		if clock - list[index].keptAt > IDLE_SECONDS then
			list[index][partKey]:Destroy()
			list[index] = list[#list]
			list[#list] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function stopWhenEmpty()
	if next(pools) == nil and #keptHolders == 0 and #keptParts == 0 and heartbeat then
		heartbeat:Disconnect()
		heartbeat = nil
	end
end

-- LockedToPart particles ride their helper: it stands where the parent is now (a part's takes its
-- size). A shared holder moves once a frame.
local function follow(emitter, pool)
	local frame = parentFrame(emitter)
	local holder = pool.holder
	if holder then
		if pool.parent ~= emitter.Parent then
			moveTo(pool, emitter.Parent)
			holder = pool.holder
		end
		if holder.followed ~= frameNumber then
			holder.followed = frameNumber
			holder.part.CFrame = frame
		end
		return
	end
	local size = emitter.Parent.Size
	for _, helper in ipairs(pool.helpers) do
		if helper.lifeLeft > 0 then
			helper.host.CFrame = frame * helper.tilt
			helper.host.Size = size
		end
	end
end

function RollLock.step(dt)
	frameNumber += 1
	clock += dt
	for emitter, pool in pairs(pools) do
		-- In the emitter's time: a TimeScale of 0 holds them.
		local passed = dt * math.max(emitter.TimeScale, 0)
		local alive = false
		for _, helper in ipairs(pool.helpers) do
			helper.lifeLeft = math.max(0, helper.lifeLeft - passed)
			if helper.lifeLeft > 0 then
				alive = true
			end
		end
		if alive then
			pool.idle = 0
			if emitter.LockedToPart and RollLock.applies(emitter) and pool.onPart == emitter.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
				follow(emitter, pool)
			end
		else
			pool.idle += dt
			if pool.idle > IDLE_SECONDS then
				releasePool(emitter, pool)
			end
		end
	end
	retire(keptHolders, "part")
	retire(keptParts, "host")
	stopWhenEmpty()
end

function RollLock.reset()
	for emitter, pool in pairs(pools) do
		releasePool(emitter, pool)
	end
	for _, holder in ipairs(keptHolders) do
		holder.part:Destroy()
	end
	for _, helper in ipairs(keptParts) do
		helper.host:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(keptHolders)
	table.clear(keptParts)
	spinning:clear()
	stopWhenEmpty()
end

local function newPool(emitter)
	local parent = emitter.Parent
	local onPart = parent:IsA("BasePart")
	local pool = { emitter = emitter, onPart = onPart, parent = parent, helpers = {}, idle = 0, turn = 0, connections = {} }
	if not onPart then
		pool.holder = claimHolder(parent)
	end
	-- Looks and motion reach the helpers at once; Rate is never copied, so a Container writing it
	-- copies nothing.
	table.insert(pool.connections, emitter.Changed:Connect(function(property)
		if not IS_COPIED[property] then
			return
		end
		-- Follow Spin writes each burst's RotSpeed itself.
		if property == "RotSpeed" and emitter:GetAttribute("FollowSpin") == true then
			return
		end
		local value = emitter[property]
		for _, helper in ipairs(pool.helpers) do
			helper.emitter[property] = value
		end
	end))
	table.insert(pool.connections, emitter.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if pools[emitter] == pool and not emitter:IsDescendantOf(game) then
			releasePool(emitter, pool)
			stopWhenEmpty()
		end
	end))
	pools[emitter] = pool
	if not heartbeat then
		heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(RollLock.step)
	end
	return pool
end

-- The emitter's pool: moved with it to another attachment, made again when its parent changed
-- kind or its holder went.
local function poolOf(emitter)
	local pool = pools[emitter]
	local parent = emitter.Parent
	if pool and pool.onPart == parent:IsA("BasePart") and (not pool.holder or pool.holder.part.Parent ~= nil) then
		if pool.holder and pool.parent ~= parent then
			moveTo(pool, parent)
		end
		pool.parent = parent
		return pool
	end
	if pool then
		releasePool(emitter, pool)
	end
	return newPool(emitter)
end

-- A helper for the pool, given back or new, with everything COPIED.
local function newHelper(pool)
	local emitter = pool.emitter
	local helper
	if pool.onPart then
		local source = emitter.Parent
		helper = takeKept(keptParts, "host")
		if helper then
			helper.host.Size = source.Size
			helper.host.CFrame = source.CFrame
		else
			local host = VisualHost.newCarrier("RollLock", source.Size, source.CFrame, VisualHost.getFolder())
			helper = { host = host }
		end
		helper.host.Shape = if source:IsA("Part") then source.Shape else Enum.PartType.Block
	else
		helper = takeKept(pool.holder.spare, "host")
		if not helper then
			local host = Instance.new("Attachment")
			host.Name = "RollLock"
			host.Parent = pool.holder.part
			helper = { host = host }
		end
	end
	if not helper.emitter then
		local helperEmitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		helperEmitter.Enabled = false
		helperEmitter.Rate = 0
		helperEmitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.zero
		helperEmitter.Parent = helper.host
		helper.emitter = helperEmitter
		helper.usedFrame = -1
		helper.lifeLeft = 0
	end
	helper.tilt = CFrame.identity
	copyInto(emitter, helper.emitter)
	table.insert(pool.helpers, helper)
	return helper
end

-- A helper free to aim: not aimed this frame, and without live LockedToPart particles. Past the
-- cap, taken in turn.
local function takeHelper(pool)
	local helpers = pool.helpers
	for index = #helpers, 1, -1 do
		-- Gone with the runtime folder.
		if helpers[index].host.Parent == nil then
			table.remove(helpers, index)
		end
	end
	local follows = pool.emitter.LockedToPart
	for _, helper in ipairs(helpers) do
		if helper.usedFrame ~= frameNumber and (not follows or helper.lifeLeft <= 0) then
			return helper, true
		end
	end
	if #helpers < MOST_HELPERS then
		return newHelper(pool), true
	end
	pool.turn = pool.turn % #helpers + 1
	return helpers[pool.turn], false
end

function RollLock.emit(emitter, count)
	if count <= 0 then
		return
	end
	if not RollLock.applies(emitter) or not emitter:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		emitter:Emit(count)
		return
	end
	local pool = poolOf(emitter)
	local frame = parentFrame(emitter)
	if pool.holder then
		pool.holder.part.CFrame = frame
	end
	local localDirection = Vector3.FromNormalId(emitter.EmissionDirection)
	local spread = emitter.SpreadAngle
	local spreads = spread.X ~= 0 or spread.Y ~= 0
	local directions = spreads and math.min(count, MOST_DIRECTIONS) or 1
	local rotation = emitter.Rotation
	local rotSpeed = emitter.RotSpeed
	local spin = 0
	local follows = emitter:GetAttribute("FollowSpin") == true
	if follows then
		spin = SPIN_SIGN * spinAbout(emitter, frame:VectorToWorldSpace(localDirection))
	end
	local lifetime = emitter.Lifetime.Max
	if spreads and not random then
		random = Random.new()
	end
	for index = 1, directions do
		local helper, aim = takeHelper(pool)
		if aim then
			helper.tilt = spreads and RollLock.tilt(localDirection, spread, random) or CFrame.identity
			if pool.onPart then
				helper.host.CFrame = frame * helper.tilt
				helper.host.Size = emitter.Parent.Size
			else
				helper.host.CFrame = helper.tilt
			end
			local turn = RollLock.correction(frame * helper.tilt, localDirection)
			helper.emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(rotation.Min + turn, rotation.Max + turn)
		end
		-- RotSpeed is read at birth: a burst's own, or the emitter's again once Follow Spin is off.
		if follows or helper.spun then
			helper.spun = follows
			helper.emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(rotSpeed.Min + spin, rotSpeed.Max + spin)
		end
		helper.usedFrame = frameNumber
		helper.lifeLeft = math.max(helper.lifeLeft, lifetime)
		local share = count // directions
		if index <= count % directions then
			share += 1
		end
		helper.emitter:Emit(share)
	end
	pool.idle = 0
end

function RollLock.pools()
	return pools, keptHolders, keptParts
end

return RollLock

--[[
	Rope Mixin  -  Emit + Animate + Update for verlet-chain ropes. The chain is a kinematic
	simulation (VerletSim.luau) driving anchored segment Parts via BulkMoveTo, with no engine physics.

	Timescale: verlet is not time-reversible, so freeze/reverse holds the pose (physDt = 0) while
	color/transparency graphs keep playing backwards.

	The rig Model stamps _lightningBolt so EmitPointLight fans nested lights out per segment
	(PointLight.luau reads it).
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local ContainerFade = require(script.Parent.Container.Fade)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local TurbulenceMod = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local VerletSim = require(script.VerletSim)
local Anchors = require(script.Anchors)
local PDataBuilder = require(script.PDataBuilder)

local MAX_ROPE_SEGMENTS = 48
local FAR_CFRAME = CFrame.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)

-- Weak-keyed by rig Model so buffers survive pool release/acquire cycles.
local Rigs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

return function(Particle)

-- Rope discriminator for the Emit and EmitAnimate dispatch.
function Particle._isRope(item)
	return item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsRope") == true
end

-- One segment part cloned from the RT; copyBare strips Transformed children (nested source
-- Part-Icles fire once per rope via NestedEmit.walk).
local function buildSegment(rt)
	local seg = Pool.copyBare(rt)
	seg.Anchored = true
	seg.CanCollide = false
	seg.CanQuery = false
	seg.CanTouch = false
	seg.Massless = true
	seg.Locked = true
	seg.Archivable = false
	local decal = seg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal") or seg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Texture")
	return seg, decal
end

local function segCapFor(data)
	return math.clamp(math.floor((data.SegmentCount and data.SegmentCount.Max or 12) + 0.5), 2, MAX_ROPE_SEGMENTS)
end

local function buildRig(data)
	local cap = segCapFor(data)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Rope"
	model.Archivable = false
	-- Consumed by EmitPointLight: nested lights fan out per segment (PointLight.luau).
	model:SetAttribute("_lightningBolt", true)
	local rig = {
		segCap = cap,
		partCount = cap,
		parts = table.create(cap),
		decals = table.create(cap),
		segLen = table.create(cap),
		widthScale = table.create(cap),
		writeCFs = table.create(cap),
		posBuf = table.create(cap + 1),
		prevPosBuf = table.create(cap + 1),
	}
	for i = 1, cap do
		local seg, decal = buildSegment(data.RenderTemplate)
		seg.Name = "Seg" .. i
		seg.CFrame = FAR_CFRAME
		seg.Parent = model
		rig.parts[i] = seg
		rig.decals[i] = decal
		rig.segLen[i] = 0.05
		rig.widthScale[i] = 1
		rig.writeCFs[i] = FAR_CFRAME
	end
	Rigs[model] = rig
	return model, rig
end

-- Pool acquire; a foreign or layout-drifted rig is rebuilt.
local function acquireRope(data)
	local expected = segCapFor(data)
	if data.Pool == true then
		local model = Pool.acquire(data.RenderTemplate, "Rope")
		if model then
			local rig = Rigs[model]
			if rig and rig.segCap == expected and rig.parts[1] and rig.parts[1].Parent == model then
				model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
				return model, rig
			end
			pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
		end
	end
	local model, rig = buildRig(data)
	model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	return model, rig
end

-- Step-gated visual write over every segment and decal. Size.Z comes from segLen.
local function writeVisuals(pData, t)
	local graphs, seeds = pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds
	local trans = graphs.Transparency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Transparency, seeds.Transparency) or 0
	if pData.SkipTransparency then trans = pData._curTrans or trans end
	local bright = graphs.Brightness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Brightness, seeds.Brightness) or 1
	local color
	if graphs.Color and not pData.SkipColor then
		local c = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.Color)
		color = Color3.new(math.min(c.R * bright, 1), math.min(c.G * bright, 1), math.min(c.B * bright, 1))
	end
	local thick = graphs.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Thickness, seeds.Thickness)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local thickChanged = thick and thick ~= pData._curThick
	if thick then pData._curThick = thick end
	pData._curTrans = trans
	-- What the segments show: a Container's Transparency fades the rope on top of its own.
	local shown = ContainerFade.number(trans, ContainerFade.of(pData._drive))
	for i = 1, rig.segCap do
		local seg = rig.parts[i]
		seg.Transparency = shown
		if color then seg.Color = color end
		local decal = rig.decals[i]
		if decal then
			decal.Transparency = shown
			if color then decal.Color3 = color end
		end
		if thickChanged then
			local w = math.max(0.05, thick * rig.widthScale[i])
			seg.Size = Vector3.new(w, w, rig.segLen[i])
		end
	end
end

-- Point buffers to segment CFrames and lengths. Size.Z tracks the actual point distance so a
-- stretched rope shows no gaps. atEmit writes CFrames directly (model unparented; BulkMoveTo needs
-- workspace ancestry).
local function writeSegments(pData, atEmit)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local pos = rig.posBuf
	local n = pData._segCount
	local thick = pData._curThick or 0.15
	for i = 1, n do
		local p0 = pos[i]
		local p1 = pos[i + 1]
		local seg = p1 - p0
		local len = seg.Magnitude
		local mid = (p0 + p1) * 0.5
		if len > 1e-4 then
			rig.writeCFs[i] = CFrame.lookAt(mid, p1)
		else
			rig.writeCFs[i] = CFrame.new(mid)
		end
		if math.abs(len - rig.segLen[i]) > 0.01 then
			rig.segLen[i] = math.max(len, 0.05)
			local w = math.max(0.05, thick * rig.widthScale[i])
			rig.parts[i].Size = Vector3.new(w, w, rig.segLen[i])
		end
	end
	for i = n + 1, rig.segCap do
		rig.writeCFs[i] = FAR_CFRAME
	end
	if atEmit then
		for i = 1, rig.segCap do
			rig.parts[i].CFrame = rig.writeCFs[i]
		end
	else
		workspace:BulkMoveTo(rig.parts, rig.writeCFs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
	end
end

function Particle:EmitRope(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local model, rig = acquireRope(data)
	local pData = PDataBuilder.build(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx, link)

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	if data.Pool == true then
		pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Rope"
	end
	-- Carried by a Matte: the segments are windows in its layer, boxed along the rope (Matte/init).
	self:_matteCarry(emitCtx, pData, rig.parts, "Spine")

	Anchors.seedPose(pData)
	pData._curThick = data.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Thickness, pData.Seeds.Thickness) or 0.15
	writeSegments(pData, true)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)
	model.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()
	Pool.restoreTrails(model, "Rope")
	ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(model, self:_makeAliveCheck())

	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, model, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx)
end

-- Animate mode: singleton persistent rope per source (fresh rig, never pooled).
function Particle:EmitRopeAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local model, rig = buildRig(data)
	model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	local pData = PDataBuilder.build(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx, link)
	pData.IsAnimate = true
	pData.AnimateItem = item

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	Anchors.seedPose(pData)
	pData._curThick = data.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Thickness, pData.Seeds.Thickness) or 0.15
	writeSegments(pData, true)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)
	model.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()
	ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(model, self:_makeAliveCheck())

	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, model, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx)
end

-- Per-frame update: fixed-substep verlet with anchors re-pinned every substep. Reverse Timescale:
-- the chain simulates FORWARD while authored inputs (anchors, graphs, Speed drift, Launch arc)
-- rewind; Timescale 0 freezes.
function Particle:UpdateRope(pData, dt, currentTime)
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local prevEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = prevEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff

	local model = pData.VisualPart
	if not model or not model.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local isDying = real_i >= 1 and (newEff >= lifeTime or newEff <= 0)

	if not isDying then
		local frozen = pData._timeFrozen == true
		local simDt = frozen and 0 or math.min(math.abs(dtTs), 0.25)
		-- Signed accumulation uses the CLAMPED effective-time delta: once the
		-- clock pins at 0 (or LifeTime) the drift stops instead of over-running.
		local motionDt = math.clamp(newEff - prevEff, -0.25, 0.25)
		local physDtEarly = simDt
		local li = math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1)
		-- Lifecycle length: GrowIn pays out over the first window, Retract reels
		-- back over the death window, Release drops every pin once.
		local lenFactor = 1
		if pData._growIn > 0 and li < pData._growIn then
			lenFactor = math.max(li / pData._growIn, 0.02)
		end
		if pData._deathMode == "Retract" then
			local deathStart = 1 - pData._deathWindow
			if li > deathStart then
				lenFactor = lenFactor * math.max(1 - (li - deathStart) / pData._deathWindow, 0.02)
			end
		elseif pData._deathMode == "Release" and not pData._released and li > 1 - pData._deathWindow then
			pData._released = true
			pData._pinStart = false
			pData._pinEnd = false
		end
		pData._restLenEff = pData._restLen * lenFactor

		-- Signed accumulation: reverse Timescale un-winds the Speed/Accel drift.
		if pData._hasMotion and motionDt ~= 0 then
			local sp = pData.Graphs.Speed and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed) or 0
			if pData._drag ~= 0 then sp = sp * math.exp(-pData._drag * newEff) end
			pData._motionAccelVel = pData._motionAccelVel + pData._accel * motionDt
			pData._motionOffset = pData._motionOffset
				+ (pData._speedDir or pData._motionDir) * (sp * motionDt)
				+ pData._motionAccelVel * motionDt
		end
		if pData._hasDisp or pData._hasTurb or pData._hasMotion then
			local off = Vector3.zero
			if pData._hasDisp then
				local graphs, seeds = pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds
				off = Vector3.new(
					graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, graphs.PosOffsetX, seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0,
					graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, graphs.PosOffsetY, seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0,
					graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, graphs.PosOffsetZ, seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0)
			end
			if pData._hasTurb then
				off = off + TurbulenceMod.sampleRaw(pData.Graphs.Turbulence, pData.Seeds.Turbulence,
					pData._turbSeed, pData._turbFreq, lifeTime, li)
			end
			if pData._dispMode ~= "Global" then
				off = Anchors.resolveStart(pData).Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(off)
			end
			if pData._hasMotion then
				off = off + pData._motionOffset
			end
			pData._anchorOffWorld = off
		else
			pData._anchorOffWorld = nil
		end
		if pData._pinMode == "Launch" then
			-- The hook bites once (the latch is permanent: reverse Timescale rewinds only pre-bite flight, and
			-- AnimateLoop cycles keep it). aimed = live target on arrival; blind = the world point where the
			-- rope first went taut.
			if pData._launchArrived then
				if pData._launchT then
					local target = pData._target
					if target and target.Parent then
						pData._launchPos = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(target).Position
					end
				end
			elseif pData._launchT and newEff >= pData._launchT then
				pData._launchArrived = true
				local target = pData._target
				if target and target.Parent then
					pData._launchPos = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(target).Position
				end
			else
				local delta = pData._launchVel * newEff + pData._gravity * (0.5 * newEff * newEff)
				if not pData._launchT then
					local maxLen = pData._restLen * pData._segCount
					if delta.Magnitude >= maxLen then
						delta = delta.Unit * maxLen
						pData._launchArrived = true
					end
				end
				pData._launchPos = pData._launchOrigin + delta
			end
		end

		local physDt = physDtEarly
		if physDt > 1e-6 then
			pData._windPhase = pData._windPhase + pData._windFreq * physDt
			local rig = pData._rig
			-- Slow Timescale shrinks the substep (smooth slow motion, one step per frame) rather than thinning
			-- the cadence, which would stutter. Fast Timescale keeps 1/60 steps and adds more of them.
			local h = math.min(physDt, VerletSim.SUBSTEP)
			local accum = pData._accum + physDt
			local steps = 0
			while accum >= h and steps < VerletSim.MAX_SUBSTEPS do
				Anchors.repin(pData)
				VerletSim.step(rig.posBuf, rig.prevPosBuf, pData._segCount, pData, h, pData._windPhase)
				accum -= h
				steps += 1
			end
			-- Drop excess at the cap: a hitch slows the rope, never explodes it.
			pData._accum = steps == VerletSim.MAX_SUBSTEPS and 0 or accum
			Anchors.repin(pData)
			writeSegments(pData, false)
		end
	end

	local targetStep = math.floor(math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1) * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		writeVisuals(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	end

	return isDying
end

-- AnimateLoop per-cycle refresh (EngineReplay dispatch). Pose-preserving: the point buffers survive
-- when the chain layout (segCount + restLen) is unchanged; a layout change re-seeds.
function Particle:_refreshRopeAnimate(pData, freshData)
	-- Generic replay assigns pData.Link from freshData; Rope resolves anchors itself.
	pData.Link = nil
	local oldSeg = pData._segCount
	local oldRest = pData._restLen

	local expected = segCapFor(freshData)
	local rebuilt = false
	if expected ~= pData._rig.segCap and freshData.RenderTemplate then
		local oldModel = pData.VisualPart
		local parent = oldModel and oldModel.Parent
		local model, rig = buildRig(freshData)
		model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
		pData.VisualPart = model
		pData._rig = rig
		model.Parent = parent or self:GetFolder()
		if oldModel then pcall(function() oldModel:Destroy() end) end
		rebuilt = true
	end

	PDataBuilder.readRopeParams(pData, freshData, pData._rig)
	if rebuilt then pcall(function() pData.VisualPart.WorldPivot = Anchors.resolveStart(pData) end) end
	pData._accum = 0
	pData._released = false
	pData.SkipColor = nil

	-- Launch is pose-preserving too: the latch (_launchArrived / _launchPos) survives the refresh, so a
	-- bitten hook stays bitten.
	if rebuilt or pData._segCount ~= oldSeg or math.abs((pData._restLen or 0) - (oldRest or 0)) > 1e-4 then
		Anchors.seedPose(pData)
		pData._launchArrived = false
		pData._launchPos = nil
	end
	pData._curThick = freshData.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, freshData.Thickness, pData.Seeds.Thickness) or pData._curThick
	writeSegments(pData, false)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)
end

end

--[[
	Rope/Anchors: live anchor resolution and pinning for the verlet chain.

	Start anchor: parent-clone link (nested emit), then source item, then frozen last pose. End anchor
	(PinMode BothEnds): the Target ObjectValue's instance; if Target is destroyed mid-life the rope
	degrades to StartOnly with a velocity kill, so the freed end swings from its pose instead of snapping.

	repin runs before EVERY substep (a moving source or Target drags the rope). A start-anchor jump
	over TELEPORT_DIST in one repin rigid-translates the whole chain.
]]

local Constants = require(script.Parent.Parent.PartConstants)
local VerletSim = require(script.Parent.VerletSim)

local TELEPORT_DIST = 50

local Anchors = {}

-- Spawn offset in the chosen frame: Local = base rotation x spawn RotXYZ, Global = world axes.
local function applySpawnOff(pData, cf)
	local off = pData._spawnOff
	if not off or off.Magnitude == 0 then return cf end
	if pData._spawnOffMode == "Global" then
		return cf + off
	end
	local rot = pData._spawnRot
	if rot then
		return cf + (cf.Rotation * rot):VectorToWorldSpace(off)
	end
	return cf * CFrame.new(off)
end

-- Start-anchor CFrame: override, live link, source, then frozen last; plus the rolled spawn offset
-- when SpawnTarget is Start. _lastStartCF caches the PRE-offset base so re-rolled offsets apply to the live pose.
function Anchors.resolveStart(pData)
	local cf
	if pData._startCFOverride then
		cf = pData._startCFOverride
	else
		local link = pData._parentLink
		if link and link.Parent then
			cf = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
			-- Carried by a Container or a Matte: where the emitter stands on that link (NestedEmit.keepPlace).
			if pData._parentOffset then
				cf = cf * pData._parentOffset
			end
		else
			local src = pData._sourceItem
			cf = (src and src.Parent) and src.CFrame or (pData._lastStartCF or CFrame.new())
		end
		pData._lastStartCF = cf
	end
	if pData._spawnTarget ~= "End" then
		cf = applySpawnOff(pData, cf)
	end
	return cf
end

-- End-anchor position, or nil when unpinned. Launch mode pins to the ballistic point (UpdateRope's
-- closed-form _launchPos, clamped at full extension) and never degrades. A destroyed Target flips
-- the rope to StartOnly permanently (velocity killed once).
function Anchors.resolveEnd(pData)
	if not pData._pinEnd then return nil end
	if pData._pinMode == "Launch" then
		return pData._launchPos or pData._launchOrigin
	end
	local target = pData._target
	if target and target.Parent then
		local cf = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(target)
		if pData._spawnTarget == "End" then
			cf = applySpawnOff(pData, cf)
		end
		pData._lastEndPos = cf.Position
		return cf.Position
	end
	pData._pinEnd = false
	local rig = pData._rig
	VerletSim.calm(rig.posBuf, rig.prevPosBuf, pData._segCount)
	return nil
end

-- Pins anchor points into the buffers, with a teleport guard on the start anchor. The MotionTarget
-- anchor gets _anchorOffWorld added (whips drive the START; End with StartOnly pins nothing to offset).
function Anchors.repin(pData)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local pos = rig.posBuf
	local prev = rig.prevPosBuf
	local n = pData._segCount
	local off = pData._anchorOffWorld

	-- Release death mode: no pins, the whole rope falls free.
	if pData._pinStart ~= false then
		local startPos = Anchors.resolveStart(pData).Position
		if off and pData._motionTarget == "Start" then
			startPos = startPos + off
		end
		local jump = startPos - pos[1]
		if jump.Magnitude > TELEPORT_DIST then
			VerletSim.translate(pos, prev, n, jump)
		end
		pos[1] = startPos
		prev[1] = startPos
	end

	local endPos = Anchors.resolveEnd(pData)
	if endPos then
		if off and pData._motionTarget == "End" then
			endPos = endPos + off
		end
		pos[n + 1] = endPos
		prev[n + 1] = endPos
	end
end

-- Seeds the initial pose: a straight line start to end with a slack belly, a straight hang for
-- StartOnly, or a compressed coil along the launch direction (stacking all points at one spot
-- would make relaxation explode randomly). prev := pos, so spawn is calm.
function Anchors.seedPose(pData)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local pos = rig.posBuf
	local n = pData._segCount
	local startPos = Anchors.resolveStart(pData).Position

	-- GrowIn: a compressed coil at the start; the animated rest length pays the rope out.
	if (pData._growIn or 0) > 0 and pData._pinMode ~= "Launch" then
		local dir = pData._motionDir or Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
		local spacing = pData._restLen * 0.02
		for i = 1, n + 1 do
			pos[i] = startPos + dir * (spacing * (i - 1))
		end
		VerletSim.calm(pos, rig.prevPosBuf, n)
		return
	end

	if pData._pinMode == "Launch" then
		local dir = pData._launchVel
		dir = (dir and dir.Magnitude > 1e-4) and dir.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
		local spacing = pData._restLen * 0.05
		for i = 1, n + 1 do
			pos[i] = startPos + dir * (spacing * (i - 1))
		end
		VerletSim.calm(pos, rig.prevPosBuf, n)
		return
	end

	local endPos = Anchors.resolveEnd(pData)

	if endPos then
		local chord = endPos - startPos
		-- Belly depth from the length surplus over the straight chord.
		local surplus = math.max(pData._restLen * n - chord.Magnitude, 0)
		for i = 1, n + 1 do
			local t = (i - 1) / n
			pos[i] = startPos + chord * t - Vector3.new(0, surplus * 0.5 * 4 * t * (1 - t), 0)
		end
	else
		-- StartOnly: seeded EXTENDED along EmissionDirection +- SpreadAngle; the rope bursts out, then gravity settles it.
		local dir = pData._motionDir or Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
		for i = 1, n + 1 do
			pos[i] = startPos + dir * (pData._restLen * (i - 1))
		end
	end
	VerletSim.calm(pos, rig.prevPosBuf, n)
end

return Anchors

--[[
	Rope/PDataBuilder: per-rope pData construction, shared by Emit, Animate and the AnimateLoop
	refresh (which re-reads via readRopeParams so live edits apply each cycle).
	Rope length: RopeLength <= 0 is auto (anchor distance x Slack; 10 x Slack when unpinned or no Target).
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Range)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.Parent.PartConstants)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Parent.Turbulence)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.AxisLinks)
local Anchors = require(script.Parent.Anchors)

local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

local PDataBuilder = {}

-- Flat-zero displacement graphs count as no motion, so idle ropes skip sampling.
local function liveGraph(seq)
	if not seq then return nil end
	if GraphMod.IsStatic(seq) and GraphMod.GetStaticValue(seq, 0) == 0 then return nil end
	return seq
end

-- Rope-parameter block written onto pData. Refresh calls it too, so every field must be safe to overwrite mid-life.
function PDataBuilder.readRopeParams(pData, data, rig, emitCtx)
	pData._pinMode = data.PinMode or "BothEnds"
	pData._target = data.Target
	pData._pinStart = true
	pData._pinEnd = (pData._pinMode == "BothEnds" and data.Target ~= nil) or pData._pinMode == "Launch"
	pData._segCount = math.clamp(math.floor(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.SegmentCount) + 0.5), 2, rig.segCap)
	pData._stiffness = math.clamp(math.floor((data.Stiffness or 4) + 0.5), 1, 10)
	pData._bendStiffness = math.clamp(data.BendStiffness or 0, 0, 1)
	pData._damping = math.clamp(data.Damping or 0.03, 0, 0.5)
	pData._gravity = data.Gravity or Vector3.new(0, -40, 0)
	pData._windAmp = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.WindAmplitude)
	pData._windFreq = data.WindFrequency or 2

	-- GrowIn pays the rope out over the first fraction of life; DeathMode ends it (Retract reels in, Release drops all pins).
	pData._growIn = math.clamp(data.GrowIn or 0, 0, 0.9)
	pData._deathMode = data.DeathMode or "None"
	pData._deathWindow = math.clamp(data.DeathWindow or 0.2, 0.05, 0.9)

	-- Taper: ThicknessProfile sampled along the arc (0 root, 1 tip) into a per-segment width scale.
	local profile = data.ThicknessProfile
	local flatProfile = not profile or GraphMod.IsStatic(profile)
	local profileSeed = (not flatProfile) and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(profile) or nil
	for i = 1, rig.segCap do
		if flatProfile then
			rig.widthScale[i] = profile and GraphMod.GetStaticValue(profile, 1) or 1
		else
			rig.widthScale[i] = math.max(GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime((i - 0.5) / rig.segCap, profile, profileSeed), 0.05)
		end
	end

	-- Anchor motion: Displacement graphs + Turbulence aimed at one anchor.
	pData._motionTarget = data.MotionTarget or "Start"
	pData._dispMode = data.DisplacementMode or "Global"
	local ox = liveGraph(data.PosOffsetX)
	local oy = liveGraph(data.PosOffsetY)
	local oz = liveGraph(data.PosOffsetZ)
	pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX = ox
	pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY = oy
	pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ = oz
	pData._hasDisp = (ox or oy or oz) ~= nil
	if ox then pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX = pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(ox) end
	if oy then pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY = pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(oy) end
	if oz then pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ = pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(oz) end
	local turb = Turbulence.isLive(data.Turbulence)
	pData.Graphs.Turbulence = turb
	pData._hasTurb = turb ~= nil
	if turb then
		pData.Seeds.Turbulence = pData.Seeds.Turbulence or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(turb)
		pData._turbFreq = data.TurbulenceFrequency or 1
		pData._turbSeed = pData._turbSeed or (math.random() * 997 + 0.5)
	end

	-- Spawn frame: RotXYZ rolled per rope (even-distribution aware) rotates the aim and the Local spawn
	-- offset frame. Pos offset applies to the SpawnTarget anchor (Anchors resolves it).
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX", "RotY", "RotZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", rotS.RotX or 0, rotS.RotY or 0, rotS.RotZ or 0)
	pData._spawnRot = rotXYZ
	local posS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"PosX", "PosY", "PosZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	pData._spawnOff = Vector3.new(posS.PosX or 0, posS.PosY or 0, posS.PosZ or 0)
	pData._spawnOffMode = data.PosMode or "Local"
	pData._spawnTarget = data.SpawnTarget or "Start"

	-- Emit-frame origin, needed for auto rope length and direction composition.
	local originCF = Anchors.resolveStart(pData)

	-- Aim = EmissionDirection in the RotXYZ frame +- SpreadAngle, composed at emit and frozen (a thrown
	-- hook does not re-aim when the source moves). Seeds StartOnly poses and aims Launch throws.
	-- Speed has its own MotionDirection axis in the same frame.
	local spread = data.SpreadAngle or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	local function composeDir(normalId)
		local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[normalId] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Front]
		local axis = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, axis) * rotXYZ
		if spread.X > 0 or spread.Y > 0 then
			cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(
				math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.X),
				math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.Y), 0)
		end
		return originCF.Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(cf.LookVector)
	end
	pData._motionDir = composeDir(data.EmissionDirection)
	pData._speedDir = composeDir(data.MotionDirection or data.EmissionDirection)

	-- Speed along direction + Acceleration drift + Drag, accumulated per frame by UpdateRope into _motionOffset.
	local speedGraph = liveGraph(data.Speed)
	pData.Graphs.Speed = speedGraph
	if speedGraph then
		pData.Seeds.Speed = pData.Seeds.Speed or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(speedGraph)
	end
	pData._accel = data.Acceleration or Vector3.zero
	pData._drag = data.Drag or 0
	pData._hasMotion = speedGraph ~= nil or pData._accel.Magnitude > 0
	pData._motionOffset = Vector3.zero
	pData._motionAccelVel = Vector3.zero

	-- Launch: ballistic end anchor. With a Target the velocity is solved so the arc passes through it at
	-- T = distance / LaunchSpeed (UpdateRope then pins to the live target); without one it throws blind.
	if pData._pinMode == "Launch" then
		local speed = math.max(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.LaunchSpeed), 1)
		pData._launchOrigin = originCF.Position
		pData._launchT = nil
		local targetPos
		if data.Target then
			local ok, endCF = pcall(Constants.resolveLinkCFrame, data.Target)
			if ok and endCF then targetPos = endCF.Position end
		end
		if targetPos then
			local delta = targetPos - originCF.Position
			local T = math.max(delta.Magnitude / speed, 0.05)
			pData._launchVel = delta * (1 / T) - pData._gravity * (0.5 * T)
			pData._launchT = T
		else
			pData._launchVel = pData._motionDir * speed
		end
	end

	-- Rest length needs the anchor span; start/end are resolved cheaply here (Anchors owns the live per-substep version).
	local ropeLen = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.RopeLength)
	if ropeLen <= 0 then
		local slack = math.max(data.Slack or 1.2, 1)
		local span = 10
		if (pData._pinMode == "BothEnds" or pData._pinMode == "Launch") and data.Target then
			local ok, endCF = pcall(Constants.resolveLinkCFrame, data.Target)
			if ok and endCF then
				span = math.max((endCF.Position - originCF.Position).Magnitude, 1)
			end
		end
		ropeLen = span * slack
	end
	pData._restLen = math.max(ropeLen / pData._segCount, 0.05)
end

function PDataBuilder.build(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx, link)
	local seeds = {
		Brightness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Brightness),
		Transparency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Transparency),
		Thickness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Thickness),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	local pData = {
		Type = "Rope",
		VisualPart = model,
		_rig = rig,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = lifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		_sourceItem = item,
		Graphs = {
			Color = data.Color,
			Brightness = data.Brightness,
			Transparency = data.Transparency,
			Thickness = data.Thickness,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, lifeTime),
		_parentLink = link,
		-- Carried by a Container or a Matte: its place on the parent clone (NestedEmit.keepPlace).
		_parentOffset = emitCtx and emitCtx._rigPlace or nil,
		-- Carried by a Container: its record, for its Transparency (Container/Fade).
		_drive = emitCtx and emitCtx._containerDrive or nil,
		_accum = 0,
		_windPhase = 0,
		_windSeedA = math.random() * 1000,
		_windSeedB = 500 + math.random() * 1000,
	}

	-- An event-origin override freezes the start anchor at the event's frame.
	if emitCtx then
		local oCF
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then oCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		oCF = oCF or emitCtx.EventOriginCF
		if oCF then
			pData._startCFOverride = (emitCtx.UseFullOrigin and oCF) or CFrame.new(oCF.Position) * item.CFrame.Rotation
		end
	end

	PDataBuilder.readRopeParams(pData, data, rig, emitCtx)
	-- The rig Model has no PrimaryPart, so an unset WorldPivot tracks the live bbox, which the parked
	-- slots drag away; stamp the start anchor so nested links read it.
	pcall(function() model.WorldPivot = Anchors.resolveStart(pData) end)
	-- A fresh emit has an un-bitten hook and unreleased pins; the AnimateLoop refresh does not reset them.
	pData._launchArrived = false
	pData._released = false
	return pData
end

return PDataBuilder

--[[
	Rope/VerletSim  -  position-verlet chain over the rope rig point buffers.
	Pure math, no Roblox services, so a headless harness runs this file.

	step() integrates every FREE point (pos += (pos - prev) * (1 - damping) + (gravity + wind) * h^2)
	then runs K relaxation iterations over the adjacent-point distance constraints. Pinned points
	(start always; end when pinEnd) have weight 0: their correction goes fully to the free neighbor.
	Projection cannot add energy, so a hanging rope settles dead still.

	Caller contract (Rope/init.luau UpdateRope): fixed-substep accumulator at SUBSTEP, at most
	MAX_SUBSTEPS per frame, input dt clamped, EXCESS ACCUM DROPPED at the cap: a hitch slows the
	rope, it never explodes. Anchors re-pin before every substep (Rope/Anchors.luau).
]]

local VerletSim = {}

VerletSim.SUBSTEP = 1 / 60
VerletSim.MAX_SUBSTEPS = 3

-- Wind sample for normalized arc position s: 2-octave noise on world X/Z.
local function windAccel(s, amp, phase, seedA, seedB)
	local x1 = s * 3 - phase
	local x2 = s * 8.1 - phase * 1.6
	return Vector3.new(
		(math.noise(x1, seedA) + 0.5 * math.noise(x2, seedA + 37.1)) * amp,
		0,
		(math.noise(x1, seedB) + 0.5 * math.noise(x2, seedB + 37.1)) * amp)
end

-- One fixed substep h. pos/prev hold n+1 points; params reads pData fields: _damping,
-- _gravity (Vector3), _restLen (or animated _restLenEff), _stiffness, _pinStart (nil/true =
-- pinned; false = free), _pinEnd, _bendStiffness (0..1 second-neighbor constraints),
-- _windAmp + _windFreq seeds. windPhase is advanced by the caller in effective time.
function VerletSim.step(pos, prev, n, params, h, windPhase)
		-- The implicit velocity (pos - prev) is in units of the PREVIOUS step, so a changing h
		-- (slow-mo) rescales it by h/hPrev or momentum jumps at every speed change.
	local hPrev = params._lastH or h
	params._lastH = h
		-- Damping is per SUBSTEP of simulated time, so slow-mo must not over-damp the rope.
	local damp = 1 - (params._damping or 0)
	if h ~= VerletSim.SUBSTEP and damp < 1 and damp > 0 then
		damp = damp ^ (h / VerletSim.SUBSTEP)
	end
	local keep = damp * (h / hPrev)
	local g = params._gravity
	local windAmp = params._windAmp or 0
	local pinStart = params._pinStart ~= false
	local pinEnd = params._pinEnd
	local firstFree = pinStart and 2 or 1
	local lastFree = pinEnd and n or (n + 1)

	for i = firstFree, lastFree do
		local p = pos[i]
		local acc = g
		if windAmp ~= 0 then
			acc = acc + windAccel((i - 1) / n, windAmp, windPhase, params._windSeedA, params._windSeedB)
		end
		pos[i] = p + (p - prev[i]) * keep + acc * (h * h)
		prev[i] = p
	end

	local restLen = params._restLenEff or params._restLen
	local bend = params._bendStiffness or 0
	local iterations = params._stiffness or 4
	for _ = 1, iterations do
		for i = 1, n do
			local a = pos[i]
			local b = pos[i + 1]
			local d = b - a
			local len = d.Magnitude
			if len > 1e-6 then
				local off = d * ((len - restLen) / len)
				local aPinned = pinStart and i == 1
				local bPinned = pinEnd and (i + 1 == n + 1)
				if aPinned then
					if not bPinned then
						pos[i + 1] = b - off
					end
				elseif bPinned then
					pos[i] = a + off
				else
					local half = off * 0.5
					pos[i] = a + half
					pos[i + 1] = b - half
				end
			end
		end
		if bend > 0 then
						-- Pulls each INTERIOR point toward its neighbors' midpoint: it fights curvature
						-- directly. Endpoints never move, so pins stay exact; the distance pass restores
						-- segment lengths each iteration.
			local k = bend * 0.5
			for i = 2, n do
				local mid = (pos[i - 1] + pos[i + 1]) * 0.5
				pos[i] = pos[i] + (mid - pos[i]) * k
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Rigid-translate the whole chain (teleport guard) without adding velocity.
function VerletSim.translate(pos, prev, n, offset)
	for i = 1, n + 1 do
		pos[i] = pos[i] + offset
		prev[i] = prev[i] + offset
	end
end

-- Kills all velocities in place (prev := pos).
function VerletSim.calm(pos, prev, n)
	for i = 1, n + 1 do
		prev[i] = pos[i]
	end
end

return VerletSim
