-- ScreenEmit: Emit / Animate / Update for Blur, Bloom, ColorCorrection, Atmosphere.
-- Property-only animation, clone per emit. Animate mode is a singleton (re-emits while active drop).

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)

return function(Particle)

-- EmitParent override wins, else the local camera (Atmosphere: Lighting); the source location is never a default.
local function resolveScreenParent(data, kind)
	if data.EmitParent then return data.EmitParent end
	return VisualHost.screenEffectParent(kind)
end

-- Atmosphere uses the AtmTimescale attribute; normalized to Graphs.Timescale here.
local function buildGraphs(kind, data)
	if kind == "Blur" then
		return { BlurSize = data.BlurSize, Timescale = data.Timescale }
	elseif kind == "Bloom" then
		return { BloomIntensity = data.BloomIntensity, BloomSize = data.BloomSize, BloomThreshold = data.BloomThreshold, Timescale = data.Timescale }
	elseif kind == "CC" then
		return { CCBrightness = data.CCBrightness, CCContrast = data.CCContrast, CCSaturation = data.CCSaturation, CCTintColor = data.CCTintColor, Timescale = data.Timescale }
	elseif kind == "Atmosphere" then
		return { AtmDensity = data.AtmDensity, AtmOffset = data.AtmOffset, AtmGlare = data.AtmGlare, AtmHaze = data.AtmHaze, AtmColor = data.AtmColor, AtmDecay = data.AtmDecay, Timescale = data.AtmTimescale }
	end
	return {}
end

-- ColorSequences have no seeds.
local function buildSeeds(graphs)
	local seeds = {}
	for k, g in pairs(graphs) do
		if typeof(g) == "NumberSequence" then seeds[k] = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(g) end
	end
	return seeds
end

-- Writes a graph/color sample to the visual; kind routes to the property name. skipColor /
-- skipTransparency gate those channels (set by user Modules via payload.SetSkipColor / SetSkipTransparency).
local function writeSample(kind, visual, graphs, seeds, t, skipColor, skipTransparency)
	if kind == "Blur" and graphs.BlurSize then
		visual.Size = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.BlurSize, seeds.BlurSize)
	elseif kind == "Bloom" then
		if graphs.BloomIntensity then visual.Intensity = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.BloomIntensity, seeds.BloomIntensity) end
		if graphs.BloomSize then visual.Size = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.BloomSize, seeds.BloomSize) end
		if graphs.BloomThreshold then visual.Threshold = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.BloomThreshold, seeds.BloomThreshold) end
	elseif kind == "CC" then
		if graphs.CCBrightness and not skipTransparency then visual.Brightness = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.CCBrightness, seeds.CCBrightness) end
		if graphs.CCContrast then visual.Contrast = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.CCContrast, seeds.CCContrast) end
		if graphs.CCSaturation then visual.Saturation = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.CCSaturation, seeds.CCSaturation) end
		if graphs.CCTintColor and not skipColor then visual.TintColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.CCTintColor) end
	elseif kind == "Atmosphere" then
		if graphs.AtmDensity then visual.Density = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.AtmDensity, seeds.AtmDensity) end
		if graphs.AtmOffset then visual.Offset = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.AtmOffset, seeds.AtmOffset) end
		if graphs.AtmGlare then visual.Glare = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.AtmGlare, seeds.AtmGlare) end
		if graphs.AtmHaze then visual.Haze = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.AtmHaze, seeds.AtmHaze) end
		if graphs.AtmColor and not skipColor then visual.Color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.AtmColor) end
		if graphs.AtmDecay and not skipColor then visual.Decay = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.AtmDecay) end
	end
end

-- Atmosphere has no Enabled; PostProcessEffect kinds do.
local function kindHasEnabled(kind)
	return kind ~= "Atmosphere"
end

-- Emit mode: clones the RT, applies the initial sample BEFORE Parent (no 1-frame pop), pushes pData.
local function emitClone(self, kind, item, link, emitCtx)
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visual = data.RenderTemplate:Clone()
	visual.Archivable = false
	if kindHasEnabled(kind) then visual.Enabled = true end
	visual:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)

	local safeLife = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLife <= 0 then safeLife = 0.001 end

	local graphs = buildGraphs(kind, data)
	local seeds = buildSeeds(graphs)
	writeSample(kind, visual, graphs, seeds, 0)

	visual.Parent = resolveScreenParent(data, kind)

	local pData = {
		Type = "Screen", Kind = kind,
		VisualPart = visual,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames or 100), CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLife, PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		Graphs = graphs, Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(graphs.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLife),
		_sourceItem = item,
	}
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Singleton Animate: clone, play, destroy on end. Re-emits while active are no-ops.
local function emitAnimateInternal(self, kind, item, link, emitCtx)
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end

	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visual = data.RenderTemplate:Clone()
	visual.Archivable = false
	if kindHasEnabled(kind) then visual.Enabled = true end
	visual:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)

	local safeLife = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLife <= 0 then safeLife = 0.001 end

	local graphs = buildGraphs(kind, data)
	local seeds = buildSeeds(graphs)
	writeSample(kind, visual, graphs, seeds, 0)

	visual.Parent = resolveScreenParent(data, kind)

	local pData = {
		Type = "Screen", Kind = kind,
		VisualPart = visual,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames or 100), CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLife, PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		Graphs = graphs, Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(graphs.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLife),
		IsAnimate = true, AnimateItem = item,
	}
	pData._sourceItem = item
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end


function Particle:EmitBlur(item, link, emitCtx) emitClone(self, "Blur", item, link, emitCtx) end
function Particle:EmitBloom(item, link, emitCtx) emitClone(self, "Bloom", item, link, emitCtx) end
function Particle:EmitColorCorrection(item, link, emitCtx) emitClone(self, "CC", item, link, emitCtx) end
function Particle:EmitAtmosphere(item, link, emitCtx) emitClone(self, "Atmosphere", item, link, emitCtx) end

function Particle:EmitBlurAnimate(item, link, emitCtx) emitAnimateInternal(self, "Blur", item, link, emitCtx) end
function Particle:EmitBloomAnimate(item, link, emitCtx) emitAnimateInternal(self, "Bloom", item, link, emitCtx) end
function Particle:EmitColorCorrectionAnimate(item, link, emitCtx) emitAnimateInternal(self, "CC", item, link, emitCtx) end
function Particle:EmitAtmosphereAnimate(item, link, emitCtx) emitAnimateInternal(self, "Atmosphere", item, link, emitCtx) end

-- Per frame; returns true when the lifetime ends (Heartbeat culls via swap-and-pop).
function Particle:UpdateScreen(pData, dt, currentTime)
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end

	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: see Update.luau UpdatePart. A SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsed = newEff
	local i = elapsed / lifeTime
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	if i > 1 then i = 1 end
	if i < 0 then i = 0 end

	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local t = pData.CurrentStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		writeSample(pData.Kind, pData.VisualPart, pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds, t, pData.SkipColor, pData.SkipTransparency)
	end

	return isDying
end

end

--[[
	Sound Mixin  -  Emit + Update for Sound emitters (native Sound instance as the RenderTemplate).

	Each emit plays a copy of the RT: positional where a light would ride (Particle._rideHost: Emit
	Into, the parent copy's holder, the link clone, a Model resolving to its middle part, or a
	carrier for the source's parent, at the play's origin when it has one); Local2D copies play
	through SoundService instead. In Studio edit mode every copy plays non-positionally under the
	plugin's audio widget (VisualHost.getEditAudioHost), the only parent Studio plays plugin Sounds
	from. Volume / PlaybackSpeed are stepped envelopes over Lifetime; Lifetime 0 runs until the
	clip ends. Timescale drives the clip as well as the envelopes: the copy plays at the
	envelope's speed times the timescale and pauses while time stands still or runs backwards.
	No Animate mode (a sound has no in-place state to loop).
	Every copy is destroyed on release (LifecycleRelease._releaseVisual: no pool kind).
]]

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)

-- Lifetime 0 with a clip of unknown length (loading, or looped): the Ended signal ends the
-- particle, this only bounds it. A loading clip's real length replaces it on load.
local UNBOUNDED_LIFETIME = 3600
-- Below this timescale the clip is paused: a Sound cannot play backwards, and a PlaybackSpeed
-- of 0 still advances TimePosition in Studio.
local MIN_PLAY_RATE = 0.01

return function(Particle)

function Particle._isSound(item)
	return item:IsA("Sound")
end

-- Where a positional copy plays (Particle._rideHost); a Model resolves to its middle part.
local function resolveHost(item, data, link, emitCtx)
	local host, carrier = Particle._rideHost(item, data, link, emitCtx)
	return (Particle._partOfHost(host, false)), carrier
end

function Particle:UpdateSound(pData, dt, currentTime)
		-- Signed-reverse timescale: see Update.luau UpdatePart.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local newEff = (pData._effectiveElapsed or 0) + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt * ts)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff

	local sound = pData.VisualPart
	if not sound or not sound.Parent then return true end
	if pData._clipEnded then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local isDying = real_i >= 1 and (newEff >= lifeTime or newEff <= 0)

	local targetStep = math.floor(math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1) * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		if pData.Graphs.SndVolume then
			sound.Volume = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SndVolume, pData.Seeds.SndVolume)
		end
		if pData.Graphs.SndPlaybackSpeed then
			pData._envelopeSpeed = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SndPlaybackSpeed, pData.Seeds.SndPlaybackSpeed)
		end
	end

	local rate = ts
	if pData._timeFrozen then
		rate = 0
	end
	if rate < MIN_PLAY_RATE then
		if pData._started and not pData._heldByTimescale then
			pData._heldByTimescale = true
			sound:Pause()
		end
	else
		local speed = pData._envelopeSpeed * rate
		if speed ~= pData._appliedSpeed then
			pData._appliedSpeed = speed
			sound.PlaybackSpeed = speed
		end
		if pData._heldByTimescale then
			pData._heldByTimescale = false
			sound:Resume()
		end
	end
	return isDying
end

function Particle:EmitSound(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local sound = Instance.fromExisting(data.RenderTemplate)
	sound.Archivable = false
	sound.Playing = false
	sound.Looped = data.Looped == true
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = data.RollOffMin or 10
	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = data.RollOffMax or 10000
	pcall(function() sound:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true) end)

	local seedVolume = data.SndVolume and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SndVolume) or {}
	local seedSpeed = data.SndPlaybackSpeed and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SndPlaybackSpeed) or {}
	local seedTimescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SndTimescale)
	local speed0 = data.SndPlaybackSpeed and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.SndPlaybackSpeed, seedSpeed) or 1
	if data.SndVolume then sound.Volume = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.SndVolume, seedVolume) end
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = speed0

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	local clipBound = lifeTime <= 0
	if clipBound then
		local length = sound.IsLoaded and sound.TimeLength or 0
		lifeTime = (length > 0 and not sound.Looped) and (length / math.max(speed0, 0.01)) or UNBOUNDED_LIFETIME
	end
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local editAudioHost = VisualHost.getEditAudioHost()
	local host, carrier = nil, nil
	if editAudioHost then
		host = editAudioHost
	elseif data.Local2D then
		host = SoundService
	else
		host, carrier = resolveHost(item, data, link, emitCtx)
	end
	if not host then return end

	local pData = {
		Type = "Sound",
		VisualPart = sound,
		_carrier = carrier,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = -1,
		LifeTime = lifeTime,
		PartLife = 0,
		Graphs = {
			SndVolume = data.SndVolume,
			SndPlaybackSpeed = data.SndPlaybackSpeed,
			Timescale = data.SndTimescale,
		},
		Seeds = {
			SndVolume = seedVolume,
			SndPlaybackSpeed = seedSpeed,
			Timescale = seedTimescale,
		},
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.SndTimescale, seedTimescale, lifeTime),
		_envelopeSpeed = speed0,
		_appliedSpeed = speed0,
		_started = false,
		_heldByTimescale = false,
	}
	pData._sourceItem = item
	pData._parentAlive = NestedEmit.parentAliveFor(data, emitCtx)
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)

	sound.Parent = host
	local function play()
		if not sound.Parent then return end
				-- A copy is rarely loaded at emit, so the lifetime the envelopes and the timescale graph
				-- run over is the clip's, set here and counted from here.
		if clipBound and pData.LifeTime == UNBOUNDED_LIFETIME and sound.TimeLength > 0 and not sound.Looped then
			pData.LifeTime = sound.TimeLength / math.max(speed0, 0.01)
			pData._effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.SndTimescale, seedTimescale, pData.LifeTime)
		end
		pData.StartTime = os.clock()
		sound.TimePosition = data.StartOffset or 0
		if data.Local2D and not editAudioHost then
			SoundService:PlayLocalSound(sound)
		else
			sound:Play()
		end
		pData._started = true
	end
	if clipBound then
		sound.Ended:Once(function() pData._clipEnded = true end)
	end
	if sound.IsLoaded then
		play()
	else
		sound.Loaded:Once(play)
	end

	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

end

-- site. Field name must match between the table entry and the Update read.
local FIELDS = {
	Part = {
		{ "Speed",         "_staticSpeed",         0 },
		{ "Brightness",    "_staticBrightness",    1 },
		{ "Transparency",  "_staticTransparency",  0 },
		{ "SizeX",         "_staticSizeX",         1 },
		{ "SizeY",         "_staticSizeY",         1 },
		{ "SizeZ",         "_staticSizeZ",         1 },
		{ "RotSpeedX",     "_staticRotSpeedX",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedY",     "_staticRotSpeedY",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedZ",     "_staticRotSpeedZ",     0 },
		{ "PosOffsetX",    "_staticPosOffsetX",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetY",    "_staticPosOffsetY",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetZ",    "_staticPosOffsetZ",    0 },
		{ "AccelStrength", "_staticAccelStrength", 0 },
	},
	Attachment = {
		{ "Speed",         "_staticSpeed",         0 },
		{ "RotSpeedX",     "_staticRotSpeedX",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedY",     "_staticRotSpeedY",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedZ",     "_staticRotSpeedZ",     0 },
		{ "PosOffsetX",    "_staticPosOffsetX",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetY",    "_staticPosOffsetY",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetZ",    "_staticPosOffsetZ",    0 },
	},
	Model = {
		{ "Speed",         "_staticSpeed",         0 },
		{ "Scale",         "_staticScale",         1 },
		{ "RotSpeedX",     "_staticRotSpeedX",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedY",     "_staticRotSpeedY",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedZ",     "_staticRotSpeedZ",     0 },
		{ "PosOffsetX",    "_staticPosOffsetX",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetY",    "_staticPosOffsetY",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetZ",    "_staticPosOffsetZ",    0 },
	},
	ImageLabel = {
		{ "ImageTransparency",      "_staticImageTransparency",      0 },
		{ "BackgroundTransparency", "_staticBackgroundTransparency", 0 },
		{ "ImgSpeed",               "_staticImgSpeed",               0 },
		{ "ImgRotSpeed",            "_staticImgRotSpeed",            0 },
		{ "SizeScaleX",             "_staticSizeScaleX",             1 },
		{ "SizeScaleY",             "_staticSizeScaleY",             1 },
	},
	-- Beam props live under pData.BeamProps / pData.AnimatedProps, not pData.Graphs.
	-- Beam keeps its inline static-pass in Emit.luau / EmitAnimate.luau / Engine.luau.
}

-- Walks the type's FIELDS table. For each entry: a constant NumberSequence in pData.Graphs[name]
-- is stamped to pData[staticField] and the graph nil'd; otherwise any stale static field is cleared.
function StaticPass.apply(pData)
	if not pData or not pData.Type then return end
	local list = FIELDS[pData.Type]
	if not list then return end
	local g = pData.Graphs
	if not g then return end
	for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
		local graphName, staticField, default = entry[1], entry[2], entry[3]
		local seq = g[graphName]
		if seq and Graph.IsStatic(seq) then
			pData[staticField] = Graph.GetStaticValue(seq, default)
			g[graphName] = nil
		else
			pData[staticField] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- AnimateLoop replay support. StaticPass.apply nil'd constant graphs from pData.Graphs, and
-- AxisLinks.refreshLoopGraphsAndSeeds iterates `pairs(pData.Graphs)`, so those keys are not
-- repopulated from freshData. Call this BEFORE refresh to put them back; apply then re-detects.
function StaticPass.restoreFromFreshData(pData, freshData)
	if not pData or not freshData or not pData.Type then return end
	local list = FIELDS[pData.Type]
	if not list then return end
	local g = pData.Graphs
	if not g then return end
	for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
		local graphName = entry[1]
		if g[graphName] == nil and freshData[graphName] then
			g[graphName] = freshData[graphName]
		end
	end
end

return StaticPass

-- TexturePin: keeps texture assets resident in GPU memory so they do not redecode on first use.
-- A 1x1 ImageLabel at ImageTransparency=0.99 in a hidden ScreenGui keeps the asset decoded (fully
-- transparent images get evicted). Owner-counted: a pin survives until its last owner releases.

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local GuiHost = require(script.Parent.GuiHost)

local TexturePin = {}

local _gui = nil            -- hidden ScreenGui hosting every pin ImageLabel
local _pinned = {}          -- assetId -> ImageLabel
local _ownersOf = {}        -- assetId -> {[owner]=true,...}
local _assetsByOwner = {}   -- owner   -> {[assetId]=true,...}  reverse index for O(pins held) release
local _ANON = newproxy()    -- sentinel for pin() without owner; only clear() releases anonymous pins

-- The plugin's Modules/Leftovers removes guis of this name that an instance which ended without clear() left in CoreGui.
local function ensureGui()
	if _gui and _gui.Parent then return _gui end
	local host = GuiHost.resolveContainer()
	if not host then return nil end  -- server context: pin no-ops
	_gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	_gui.Name = "PartIclesTexturePin"
	_gui.Archivable = false
	_gui.DisplayOrder = -999
	_gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	_gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	_gui.Parent = host
	return _gui
end

-- Resolves a string ID or texture-bearing Instance to a Content ID; nil means skip.
local function _resolveAssetId(entry)
	if typeof(entry) == "string" then return entry ~= "" and entry or nil end
	if typeof(entry) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
	if entry:IsA("Decal") or entry:IsA("Texture") or entry:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or entry:IsA("Beam") or entry:IsA("Trail") then
		local t = entry.Texture; return (t and t ~= "") and t or nil
	elseif entry:IsA("ImageLabel") or entry:IsA("ImageButton") then
		local t = entry.Image; return (t and t ~= "") and t or nil
	elseif entry:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
		-- SpecialMesh.TextureId (lowercase d).
		local t = entry.TextureId; return (t and t ~= "") and t or nil
	elseif entry:IsA("MeshPart") then
		-- MeshPart.TextureID (uppercase D); checked AFTER Beam etc.
		local t = entry.TextureID; return (t and t ~= "") and t or nil
	end
end

-- SurfaceAppearance carries 4 PBR slots; all four are pinned. Other entries use _resolveAssetId.
local function _appendAssetIds(entry, list)
	if entry:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
		for _, prop in ipairs({"ColorMap", "NormalMap", "MetalnessMap", "RoughnessMap"}) do
			local ok, t = pcall(function() return entry[prop] end)
			if ok and t and t ~= "" then table.insert(list, t) end
		end
		return
	end
	local id = _resolveAssetId(entry)
	if id then table.insert(list, id) end
end

-- Pins one or many assets for `owner` (default anonymous), de-duped via `_pinned`.
function TexturePin.pin(input, owner)
	if not input then return end
	owner = owner or _ANON
	local items = (type(input) == "table") and input or { input }
	local newPins = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(items) do
		local assetId = _resolveAssetId(entry)
		if assetId then
			if not _pinned[assetId] then
				local gui = ensureGui()
				if not gui then break end  -- server context: skip remaining pins entirely
				local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
				img.Name = "Pin"; img.Image = assetId
				img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1); img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
				img.BackgroundTransparency = 1; img.ImageTransparency = 0.99 -- 1.0 culls and evicts
				img.BorderSizePixel = 0; img.ZIndex = 1
				img.Parent = gui
				_pinned[assetId] = img
				table.insert(newPins, img)
			end
			local owners = _ownersOf[assetId]; if not owners then owners = {}; _ownersOf[assetId] = owners end
			owners[owner] = true
			local assets = _assetsByOwner[owner]; if not assets then assets = {}; _assetsByOwner[owner] = assets end
			assets[assetId] = true
		end
	end
	if #newPins > 0 then task.spawn(function() pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, newPins) end) end
end

-- Pins every texture-bearing descendant of `root`; owner = root.
function TexturePin.pinSubtree(root)
	if not root then return end
	local ids = {}
	_appendAssetIds(root, ids)
	local ok, descendants = pcall(root.GetDescendants, root)
	if ok then
		for _, d in ipairs(descendants) do _appendAssetIds(d, ids) end
	end
	if #ids > 0 then TexturePin.pin(ids, root) end
end

function TexturePin.isPinned(assetId) return _pinned[assetId] ~= nil end

function TexturePin.count()
	local n = 0; for _ in pairs(_pinned) do n += 1 end; return n
end

-- Drops owner's claim. The pin is destroyed only when zero owners remain.
function TexturePin.unpin(input, owner)
	if not input then return end
	owner = owner or _ANON
	local items = (type(input) == "table") and input or { input }
	for _, entry in ipairs(items) do
		local assetId = _resolveAssetId(entry)
		if assetId and _pinned[assetId] then
			local owners = _ownersOf[assetId]
			if owners then owners[owner] = nil end
			local assets = _assetsByOwner[owner]
			if assets then assets[assetId] = nil end
			local anyOwner = false; if owners then for _ in pairs(owners) do anyOwner = true; break end end
			if not anyOwner then
				pcall(_pinned[assetId].Destroy, _pinned[assetId])
				_pinned[assetId] = nil; _ownersOf[assetId] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Releases every pin this owner holds; hooked into DescendantRemoving.
function TexturePin.releaseOwner(owner)
	if not owner then return end
	local assets = _assetsByOwner[owner]; if not assets then return end
	for assetId in pairs(assets) do
		local owners = _ownersOf[assetId]
		if owners then owners[owner] = nil end
		local anyOwner = false; if owners then for _ in pairs(owners) do anyOwner = true; break end end
		if not anyOwner and _pinned[assetId] then
			pcall(_pinned[assetId].Destroy, _pinned[assetId])
			_pinned[assetId] = nil; _ownersOf[assetId] = nil
		end
	end
	_assetsByOwner[owner] = nil
end

-- Mirror of pinSubtree; other owners' shares persist.
function TexturePin.unpinSubtree(root)
	if not root then return end
	local ids = {}
	_appendAssetIds(root, ids)
	local ok, descendants = pcall(root.GetDescendants, root)
	if ok then
		for _, d in ipairs(descendants) do _appendAssetIds(d, ids) end
	end
	if #ids > 0 then TexturePin.unpin(ids, root) end
end

-- Destroys every pin and the host ScreenGui (plugin toggle-off / Deactivate).
function TexturePin.clear()
	_pinned = {}; _ownersOf = {}; _assetsByOwner = {}
	if _gui then pcall(_gui.Destroy, _gui); _gui = nil end
end

return TexturePin

--[[
	Timescale Mixin  -  runtime timescale override for live particles + raw ParticleEmitters.

	Public API (after :Activate):
	  :SetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
	     scale      -  0 = time stop, <0 = reverse, >0 = speed multiplier.
	     duration   -  seconds before revert to original (ignored when permanent).
	     permanent  -  true: never expires; false: timed via duration;
	                false + duration=0 collapses to :ClearTimescale.
	  :ClearTimescale(item)
	  :AbsoluteSetTimescale / :AbsoluteClearTimescale (recursive; Absolute.luau).

	Dispatch:
	  - Transformed (Part-Icles) items: write `_tsOverride` + `_tsOverrideUntil` attrs;
	    SetTimescale walks `Particle.ActiveEmits` to flip existing pData; emit mixins call
	    `Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, src)` so new emits during the window inherit; Update
	    mixins gate on `currentTime < pData._tsOverrideUntil` and fall back to `Graphs.Timescale`.
	  - Raw `ParticleEmitter` instances: write `.TimeScale` directly. The original value is
	    stashed in `_origTimeScale` so concurrent calls don't lose it. `_tsGen` invalidates
	    stale `task.delay` restore closures so newer calls win.
]]

return function(Particle)

		-- Emit-site seeder. Stale attrs on src are harmless: the Update gate expires them lazily.
	function Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, src)
		if not src then return end
		pData._tsOverride = src:GetAttribute("_tsOverride")
		pData._tsOverrideUntil = src:GetAttribute("_tsOverrideUntil")
	end

	local function _setNativePE(pe, scale, duration, permanent)
		if pe:GetAttribute("_origTimeScale") == nil then
			pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_origTimeScale", pe.TimeScale) end)
		end
		pcall(function() pe.TimeScale = scale end)
				-- Generation token: a bump invalidates any pending restore closure.
		local gen = (pe:GetAttribute("_tsGen") or 0) + 1
		pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_tsGen", gen) end)
		if permanent == true then return end
		task.delay(duration, function()
			if not pe.Parent then return end
			if pe:GetAttribute("_tsGen") ~= gen then return end
			local orig = pe:GetAttribute("_origTimeScale")
			if orig ~= nil then
				pcall(function() pe.TimeScale = orig end)
				pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_origTimeScale", nil) end)
			end
			pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_tsGen", nil) end)
		end)
	end

	local function _clearNativePE(pe)
		local orig = pe:GetAttribute("_origTimeScale")
		if orig ~= nil then
			pcall(function() pe.TimeScale = orig end)
			pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_origTimeScale", nil) end)
		end
				-- Bump the gen so a pending task.delay closure from a prior timed call bails.
		local gen = (pe:GetAttribute("_tsGen") or 0) + 1
		pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_tsGen", gen) end)
		pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_tsGen", nil) end)
	end

		-- Applies a timescale override to a Transformed item or raw ParticleEmitter (see header).
	function Particle:SetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
		if not item then return end
		if typeof(scale) ~= "number" then return end
		local effectiveDuration
		if permanent == true then
			effectiveDuration = nil
		elseif typeof(duration) == "number" and duration > 0 then
			effectiveDuration = duration
		else
			self:ClearTimescale(item)
			return
		end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			_setNativePE(item, scale, effectiveDuration, permanent)
			return
		end
		local until_ = (permanent == true) and math.huge or (os.clock() + effectiveDuration)
		pcall(function()
			item:SetAttribute("_tsOverride", scale)
			item:SetAttribute("_tsOverrideUntil", until_)
		end)
		local active = self.ActiveEmits
		for i = 1, #active do
			local pData = active[i]
			if pData and pData._sourceItem == item then
				pData._tsOverride = scale
				pData._tsOverrideUntil = until_
			end
		end
	end

		-- Removes the override: restores `Graphs.Timescale` (Transformed) or `_origTimeScale` (native PE).
	function Particle:ClearTimescale(item)
		if not item then return end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			_clearNativePE(item)
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			item:SetAttribute("_tsOverride", nil)
			item:SetAttribute("_tsOverrideUntil", nil)
		end)
		local active = self.ActiveEmits
		for i = 1, #active do
			local pData = active[i]
			if pData and pData._sourceItem == item then
				pData._tsOverride = nil
				pData._tsOverrideUntil = nil
			end
		end
	end


end

--[[
	TrailEmitter Mixin  -  Emit + Update for Trail particles (emitter mode).
	Static spatial position (welded to existing Attachment0/Attachment1), animation entirely via
	graphs. Width / Transparency / Color drive through TrailGraphBlender; Brightness /
	LightEmission / LightInfluence / TextureLength / MinLength / MaxLength are per-frame scalar
	graphs sampled at the current step's i.

	Cross-file invariants:
	  - pData.Type = "TrailEmitter"  -  Heartbeat dispatch routes to UpdateTrail
	  - Lifecycle.cancelAnimation reads pData.TrailEmitterSnapshot to restore live RT (animate mode)
	  - PoolHide kind "TrailEmitter": Enabled=false on release / true on acquire
	  - data.RenderTemplate is the cloned Trail; clones share its Attachment0/Attachment1 references
	  - Carried by a Container (pData._drive, set by EmitTrail through Container/Lines.carry): its
	    Timescale runs this trail's clock, and Lines.driveTrail, LAST in UpdateTrail, puts the
	    rest of what it asks on top of what the trail's own graphs wrote this frame
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local EMPTY_SEED = {}
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local TrailGraphBlender = require(script.Parent.TrailGraphBlender)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local MeshFlipbook = require(script.Parent.Flipbook)
local ContainerLines = require(script.Parent.Container.Lines)

return function(Particle)

-- Scalar graphs sampled at each step. Keep aligned with TrailEmitterProperties.
local SCALAR_GRAPHS = {"Brightness", "LightEmission", "LightInfluence", "TextureLength", "MinLength", "MaxLength"}

local function _writeBlenderState(visual, propName, states, mergedTimesList, lastIdxField, pData, t)
	if not states or #states == 0 then return end
	if #states == 1 then
		visual[propName] = states[1].Graph
		return
	end
	local lastIdx = pData[lastIdxField] or 1
	if t < states[lastIdx].Time then lastIdx = 1 end
	local pairIdx = #states - 1
	for idx = lastIdx, #states - 1 do
		if t >= states[idx].Time and t <= states[idx + 1].Time then
			pairIdx = idx; break
		end
	end
	pData[lastIdxField] = pairIdx
	local lower = states[pairIdx]
	local upper = states[pairIdx + 1] or states[#states]
	local range = upper.Time - lower.Time
	local segmentAlpha = range > 0 and ((t - lower.Time) / range) or 0
	if upper.Transition then segmentAlpha = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(segmentAlpha, upper.Transition, EMPTY_SEED) end
	local mergedTimes = mergedTimesList and mergedTimesList[pairIdx]
	if mergedTimes then
		if propName == "Color" then
			visual[propName] = GraphMod.LerpColorGraphFast(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha, mergedTimes)
		else
			visual[propName] = GraphMod.LerpGraphFast(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha, mergedTimes)
		end
	end
end

-- Per-frame update for TrailEmitter particles.
function Particle:UpdateTrail(pData, dt, currentTime)
		-- Signed-reverse timescale: see Update.luau UpdatePart.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local drive = pData._drive
	if drive then ts = ts * drive.timescale end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	local t = i
	if not pData.SkipColor then
		_writeBlenderState(pData.VisualPart, "WidthScale",   pData.WidthStates, pData.WidthMergedTimes, "_lastWidthIdx", pData, t)
		_writeBlenderState(pData.VisualPart, "Color",        pData.ColorStates, pData.ColorMergedTimes, "_lastColorIdx", pData, t)
	end
	if not pData.SkipTransparency then
		_writeBlenderState(pData.VisualPart, "Transparency", pData.TransStates, pData.TransMergedTimes, "_lastTransIdx", pData, t)
	end

	if pData.TotalKeyFrames > 0 then
		local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
		if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local steppedI = pData.CurrentStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
			for _, key in ipairs(SCALAR_GRAPHS) do
				local graph = pData.Graphs[key]
				if graph then
					pData.VisualPart[key] = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, graph, pData.Seeds[key])
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if drive then ContainerLines.driveTrail(pData) end

	return isDying
end

local function _collectStatesAndMergedTimes(graphBlender)
	local widthStates, transStates, colorStates = TrailGraphBlender.CollectStates(graphBlender)
	local widthMergedTimes, transMergedTimes, colorMergedTimes = {}, {}, {}
	for idx = 1, #widthStates - 1 do widthMergedTimes[idx] = TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedTimes(widthStates[idx].Graph, widthStates[idx + 1].Graph) end
	for idx = 1, #transStates - 1 do transMergedTimes[idx] = TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedTimes(transStates[idx].Graph, transStates[idx + 1].Graph) end
	for idx = 1, #colorStates - 1 do colorMergedTimes[idx] = TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes(colorStates[idx].Graph, colorStates[idx + 1].Graph) end
	return widthStates, transStates, colorStates, widthMergedTimes, transMergedTimes, colorMergedTimes
end

local function _buildScalarGraphs(data)
	local graphs = { Timescale = data.TEmitTimescale }
	local seeds = { Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.TEmitTimescale) }
	for _, key in ipairs(SCALAR_GRAPHS) do
		local g = data["TEmit" .. key] or data[key]
		if g then
			graphs[key] = g
			seeds[key] = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(g)
		end
	end
	return graphs, seeds
end

-- Spawns a TrailEmitter particle: clones RenderTemplate, applies the Width / Color graphs,
-- registers in ActiveEmits.
function Particle:EmitTrail(trail, link, emitCtx)
	if not trail or not trail.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(trail, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visual = Pool.acquireOrClone(data.RenderTemplate, "TrailEmitter", data.Pool)
	visual.Archivable = false
	visual.Enabled = true

		-- Bind the ends from the AUTHORED RT references (a pooled visual still carries a previous
		-- parent's attachments): the parent clone's copy when one exists, else the source.
	local map = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentCloneMap
	local a0, a1 = data.RenderTemplate.Attachment0, data.RenderTemplate.Attachment1
	local c0 = map and a0 and map[a0]
	local c1 = map and a1 and map[a1]
	visual.Attachment0 = (c0 and c0.Parent) and c0 or a0
	visual.Attachment1 = (c1 and c1.Parent) and c1 or a1

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end
		-- visual.Lifetime is the Trail's segment fade duration, separate from particle Lifetime.
	local trailLifeRange = data.TrailLife or data.Lifetime
	local trailLifeVal = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(trailLifeRange)
	if trailLifeVal <= 0 then trailLifeVal = 0.001 end
	visual.Lifetime = trailLifeVal

	local widthStates, transStates, colorStates,
		widthMergedTimes, transMergedTimes, colorMergedTimes = _collectStatesAndMergedTimes(data.GraphBlender)

	if #widthStates > 0 then visual.WidthScale = widthStates[1].Graph end
	if #transStates > 0 then visual.Transparency = transStates[1].Graph end
	if #colorStates > 0 then visual.Color = colorStates[1].Graph end

	local graphs, seeds = _buildScalarGraphs(data)
	for _, key in ipairs(SCALAR_GRAPHS) do
		if graphs[key] then
			visual[key] = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, graphs[key], seeds[key])
		end
	end

	visual.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()

	local pData = {
		Type = "TrailEmitter",
		VisualPart = visual,
		Link = link,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		WidthStates = widthStates, TransStates = transStates, ColorStates = colorStates,
		WidthMergedTimes = widthMergedTimes, TransMergedTimes = transMergedTimes, ColorMergedTimes = colorMergedTimes,
		Graphs = graphs,
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.TEmitTimescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = trail
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, trail)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "TrailEmitter" end
	if emitCtx and emitCtx._containerDrive then
		ContainerLines.carry(pData, "Trail", emitCtx._containerDrive)
	end
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

		-- Flipbook: cycles visual.Texture through TrailFlipbooks/Decals with FlipBeam, which works
		-- on any target with a Texture property.
	if data.TrailFlipbookMode and data.TrailFlipbooks then
		local decals = MeshFlipbook.GetSortedBeamTextures(data.TrailFlipbooks)
		if #decals > 0 then
			local spec = {
				FlipbookMode = data.TrailFlipbookMode,
				FlipbookFramerate = data.TrailFlipbookFramerate,
				FlipbookStartRandom = data.TrailFlipbookStartRandom,
				FlipbookReverse = data.TrailFlipbookReverse,
			}
			MeshFlipbook.FlipBeam(pData, spec, decals, visual, safeLifeTime)
		end
	end
end

-- Animate mode: operates on the LIVE RenderTemplate. cancelAnimation/finishAnimate restore the
-- snapshotted Trail props and disable the trail when the cycle ends.
function Particle:EmitTrailAnimate(trail, link, emitCtx)
	if not trail or not trail.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[trail] then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(trail, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visual = data.RenderTemplate -- LIVE source, not a clone

		-- Snapshot BEFORE mutating so cancelAnimation restores the authored values.
	local snapshot = {
		Lifetime = visual.Lifetime,
		Brightness = visual.Brightness,
		LightEmission = visual.LightEmission,
		LightInfluence = visual.LightInfluence,
		TextureLength = visual.TextureLength,
		MinLength = visual.MinLength,
		MaxLength = visual.MaxLength,
		Texture = visual.Texture,
		TextureMode = visual.TextureMode,
		FaceCamera = visual.FaceCamera,
		WidthScale = visual.WidthScale,
		Transparency = visual.Transparency,
		Color = visual.Color,
		Enabled = visual.Enabled,
	}

	visual.Enabled = true

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end
	local trailLifeRange = data.TrailLife or data.Lifetime
	local trailLifeVal = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(trailLifeRange)
	if trailLifeVal <= 0 then trailLifeVal = 0.001 end
	visual.Lifetime = trailLifeVal

	local widthStates, transStates, colorStates,
		widthMergedTimes, transMergedTimes, colorMergedTimes = _collectStatesAndMergedTimes(data.GraphBlender)

	if #widthStates > 0 then visual.WidthScale = widthStates[1].Graph end
	if #transStates > 0 then visual.Transparency = transStates[1].Graph end
	if #colorStates > 0 then visual.Color = colorStates[1].Graph end

	local graphs, seeds = _buildScalarGraphs(data)
	for _, key in ipairs(SCALAR_GRAPHS) do
		if graphs[key] then
			visual[key] = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, graphs[key], seeds[key])
		end
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "TrailEmitter",
		VisualPart = visual,
		Link = link,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		IsAnimate = true, AnimateItem = trail,
		TrailEmitterSnapshot = snapshot,
		WidthStates = widthStates, TransStates = transStates, ColorStates = colorStates,
		WidthMergedTimes = widthMergedTimes, TransMergedTimes = transMergedTimes, ColorMergedTimes = colorMergedTimes,
		Graphs = graphs,
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.TEmitTimescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = trail
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, trail)
	self.ActiveAnimates[trail] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	if data.TrailFlipbookMode and data.TrailFlipbooks then
		local decals = MeshFlipbook.GetSortedBeamTextures(data.TrailFlipbooks)
		if #decals > 0 then
			local spec = {
				FlipbookMode = data.TrailFlipbookMode,
				FlipbookFramerate = data.TrailFlipbookFramerate,
				FlipbookStartRandom = data.TrailFlipbookStartRandom,
				FlipbookReverse = data.TrailFlipbookReverse,
			}
			MeshFlipbook.FlipBeam(pData, spec, decals, visual, safeLifeTime)
		end
	end
end

--[[
	TrailGraphBlender  -  multi-state interpolation for Trail emitter properties.
	Like Graph.CollectGraphStates but with a third Width track beside Transparency + Color.
	Configuration children under the GraphBlender folder each carry Time + Width + Transparency +
	Color attributes; the collector returns three sorted state lists. The per-frame interpolation
	reuses Graph's PrecomputeMergedTimes + LerpGraphFast / LerpColorGraphFast.
]]

local Graph = require(script.Parent.Graph)

local TrailGraphBlender = {}

-- Collects blender states from a GraphBlender folder into three time-sorted lists (width /
-- transparency / color) for Graph.PrecomputeMergedTimes + LerpGraphFast.
function TrailGraphBlender.CollectStates(graphBlender)
	local widthStates, transStates, colorStates = {}, {}, {}
	if not graphBlender then return widthStates, transStates, colorStates end

	for _, child in pairs(graphBlender:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:IsA("Configuration") then continue end
		local time = child:GetAttribute("Time")
		if time == nil then
			local num = tonumber(string.match(child.Name, "%d+"))
			time = num and (num - 1) or 0
		end
		local transition = child:GetAttribute("Transition")
		if typeof(transition) ~= "NumberSequence" then transition = nil end
		local width = child:GetAttribute("Width")
		if width and typeof(width) == "NumberSequence" then
			table.insert(widthStates, {Time = time, Graph = width, Transition = transition})
		end
		local trans = child:GetAttribute("Transparency")
		if trans and typeof(trans) == "NumberSequence" then
			table.insert(transStates, {Time = time, Graph = trans, Transition = transition})
		end
		local color = child:GetAttribute("Color")
		if color and typeof(color) == "ColorSequence" then
			table.insert(colorStates, {Time = time, Graph = color, Transition = transition})
		end
	end

	for _, states in ipairs({widthStates, transStates, colorStates}) do
		table.sort(states, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
		if #states > 1 and states[#states].Time > 1 then
			local maxTime = states[#states].Time
			if maxTime > 0 then for _, s in ipairs(states) do s.Time = s.Time / maxTime end end
		end
	end

	return widthStates, transStates, colorStates
end

TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedTimes = Graph.PrecomputeMergedTimes
TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes = Graph.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes
TrailGraphBlender.LerpGraphFast = Graph.LerpGraphFast
TrailGraphBlender.LerpColorGraphFast = Graph.LerpColorGraphFast

return TrailGraphBlender

--[[
	Transform mixin  -  makes an instance a part-icle: attributes, a PartIcleProperties Configuration
	and a RenderTemplate; the source hidden. TransformModel for Models.
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local DragModel = require(script.Parent.DragModel)
local AtRest = require(script.Parent.AtRest)

return function(Particle)

-- Fired after any Transform.
if not Particle.TransformCompleted then
	Particle.TransformCompleted = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
end

-- True when `inst` is `holder` or sits inside it.
local function isWithin(inst, holder)
	return inst == holder or inst:IsDescendantOf(holder)
end

-- What a holder carries into its RenderTemplate: native emitters, lights, attachments, transformed
-- emitters; a Beam or Trail only when both its attachments are inside.
local function isNestedContent(child, holder)
	if child:GetAttribute("Transformed") or child:IsA("Attachment") then return true end
	if child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or child:IsA("Light") then return true end
	if child:IsA("Beam") or child:IsA("Trail") then
		local attachment0 = child.Attachment0
		local attachment1 = child.Attachment1
		return (attachment0 == nil or isWithin(attachment0, holder)) and (attachment1 == nil or isWithin(attachment1, holder))
	end
	return false
end

-- The children that move into the RenderTemplate: nested content, and for a part that shows
-- nothing once transformed its own mesh, decals and textures.
local function carriedChildren(part, carriesNested, carriesLooks)
	local nested, looks = {}, {}
	for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
		if carriesNested and isNestedContent(child, part) then
			table.insert(nested, child)
		elseif carriesLooks and (child:IsA("SpecialMesh") or child:IsA("Decal")) then
			table.insert(looks, child)
		end
	end
	return nested, looks
end

-- A copy of `item` without `carried` (non-Archivable for the Clone, restored at once). They never
-- leave the item here: Studio's undo keeps a child moved between parents in the place and loses one
-- destroyed or moved through nil, so the RenderTemplate is parented first and they move in after.
local function cloneWithout(item, carried)
	local archivable = table.create(#carried)
	for index, child in ipairs(carried) do
		archivable[index] = child.Archivable
		child.Archivable = false
	end
	local copy = item:Clone()
	for index, child in ipairs(carried) do
		child.Archivable = archivable[index]
	end
	return copy
end

-- Children a transformed Model owns itself; everything else belongs in its RenderTemplate.
local MODEL_INTERNALS = { EmitParent = true, Link = true, AccelTarget = true }
MODEL_INTERNALS[TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME] = true

-- A plain Trail or Beam is promoted: it gets PartIcleProperties and becomes TrailEmitter / Beam.
function Particle:Transform(part)
	if part:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(part)
	-- A Reactor: no RenderTemplate, nothing hidden.
	if not typeDef and (part:IsA("Model") or part:IsA("BasePart")) and part:GetAttribute("IsReactor") and TypeRegistry.Types.Reactor then
		return self:TransformReactor(part, TypeRegistry.Types.Reactor)
	end
	if not typeDef then
		-- Lightning and CameraShake: their classChecks need the config made below, so resolved by hand.
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("IsLightning") and TypeRegistry.Types.Lightning then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Lightning
		elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("IsCameraShake") and TypeRegistry.Types.CameraShake then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.CameraShake
		elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("IsRocks") and TypeRegistry.Types.Rocks then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Rocks
		elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("IsRope") and TypeRegistry.Types.Rope then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Rope
		elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") and TypeRegistry.Types.Distortion then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Distortion
		elseif (part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Attachment")) and part:GetAttribute("IsContainer") and TypeRegistry.Types.Container then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Container
		elseif (part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Attachment")) and part:GetAttribute("IsForce") and TypeRegistry.Types.Force then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Force
		elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("IsMatte") and TypeRegistry.Types.Matte then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Matte
		else
			return
		end
	end
	local isLightning = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Lightning
	local isCameraShake = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.CameraShake
	local isRocks = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Rocks
	local isRope = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Rope
	local isDistortion = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Distortion
	-- Containers and Mattes are holders only: their own look, no link, target or shape children.
	local isContainer = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Container or typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Matte
	-- A Force draws nothing and emits no copy.
	local isForce = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Force

	-- Promoting: the emitter's typeDef first, so the Configuration gets its defaults.
	if typeDef.directAccess then
		if part:IsA("Trail") and TypeRegistry.Types.TrailEmitter then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.TrailEmitter
		elseif part:IsA("Beam") and TypeRegistry.Types.Beam then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Beam
		else
			return
		end
	end

	if part:IsA("Model") then
		-- No PrimaryPart needed: the pivot is computed.
		return self:TransformModel(part, typeDef)
	end

	local config = TypeRegistry.createConfig(part, typeDef)
	-- A new item's Drag is Roblox's (DragModel.luau).
	DragModel.mark(config)

	-- A Part, rig or Attachment carries its nested content in the RenderTemplate, so every copy has
	-- it. CameraShake, Distortion and Force emit no copy: their children stay. A Container keeps its
	-- look; its RenderTemplate gets a copy.
	local emitsNoClone = isCameraShake or isDistortion or isForce
	local nested, looks = carriedChildren(part, not emitsNoClone and (part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Attachment")), part:IsA("BasePart") and not isContainer)

	local renderTemplate = cloneWithout(part, table.move(looks, 1, #looks, #nested + 1, table.clone(nested)))
	renderTemplate.Name = "RenderTemplate"

	for _, child in renderTemplate:GetChildren() do
		if child:GetAttribute("Transformed") or child:IsA("Attachment") then continue end
		if child.Name == TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME or child.Name == "EmitParent" or child.Name == "Link" or child.Name == "AccelTarget" or child.Name == "Target" or child.Name == "ImageFlipbooks" then
			child:Destroy()
		elseif part:IsA("Light") or part:IsA("Highlight") or part:IsA("Sound") then
			child:Destroy()
		elseif part:IsA("Attachment") then
			-- Plugin internals go; authored Trails, Beams and Decals stay.
			if child.Name == "MeshFlipbooks" or child.Name == "BeamFlipbooks" or child.Name == "GraphBlender" then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		elseif part:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			-- UI decorators stay.
			if not child:IsA("UIComponent") then child:Destroy() end
		elseif not child:IsA("SpecialMesh") and not child:IsA("Decal") and not child:IsA("Texture") and not child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
			-- A SurfaceAppearance stays (Emit reads it).
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- Plugin attributes go; the user's stay.
	for _, attrName in ipairs({"Transformed", "Qwinkle", "IsEmitter", "EmitCount", "EmitDuration", "EmitDelay", "EmissionMode", "AnimateLoop", "PreloadTexture", "LinkMode", "LinkSource"}) do
		renderTemplate:SetAttribute(attrName, nil)
	end

	if renderTemplate:IsA("BasePart") then
		renderTemplate.Anchored = true; renderTemplate.CanCollide = false; renderTemplate.CanQuery = false
		renderTemplate.CanTouch = false; renderTemplate.CastShadow = false; renderTemplate.Massless = true; renderTemplate.Locked = true
		renderTemplate.Transparency = 1
		for _, c in ipairs(renderTemplate:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("Decal") or c:IsA("Texture") then c.Transparency = 1 end
		end
	end

	if renderTemplate:IsA("Attachment") then
		renderTemplate.CFrame = CFrame.new()
	end

	-- In the place before the item's children move in (cloneWithout).
	renderTemplate.Parent = part
	for _, child in ipairs(nested) do
		child.Parent = renderTemplate
	end

	-- The RenderTemplate's native emitters off (they ignore a hidden parent); transformed ones keep theirs.
	for _, desc in ipairs(renderTemplate:GetDescendants()) do
		if (desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail"))
			and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed")
		then desc.Enabled = false end
	end
	-- Beams and Lights off there too, on in every copy (AtRest).
	AtRest.silence(renderTemplate)

	-- The source's look becomes the defaults, read before its mesh and decals move: SpecialMesh.Scale
	-- wins for Size; decals keep their look through decal layers.
	if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part:IsA("Terrain") and not isCameraShake and not isDistortion and not isContainer and not isForce then
		local sizeVec = part.Size
		local meshChild = part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
		if meshChild then sizeVec = meshChild.Scale end
		local colorVal = part.Color
		local transparencyVal = part.Transparency
		if isLightning or isRope then
			-- Lightning and Rope: Thickness instead of Size.
			config:SetAttribute("Thickness", NumberSequence.new(math.max(0.05, math.min(part.Size.X, part.Size.Y))))
		elseif not isRocks then
			-- Rocks: chunk size = the RenderTemplate's Size x ChunkScale.
			config:SetAttribute("SizeX", NumberSequence.new(sizeVec.X))
			config:SetAttribute("SizeY", NumberSequence.new(sizeVec.Y))
			config:SetAttribute("SizeZ", NumberSequence.new(sizeVec.Z))
			config:SetAttribute("DecalLayers", true)
		end
		config:SetAttribute("Color", ColorSequence.new(colorVal))
		config:SetAttribute("Transparency", NumberSequence.new(transparencyVal))
	end

	-- The source hides; its mesh, decals and textures are in the RenderTemplate.
	if part:IsA("BasePart") and not isContainer then
		for _, child in ipairs(looks) do
			child.Parent = renderTemplate
			if child:IsA("Decal") then child.Transparency = 1 end
		end
		part.Transparency = 1
		-- Rocks spawn at the source: a solid invisible source would throw them apart.
		if isRocks then part.CanCollide = false end
	elseif part:IsA("Light") then
		part.Enabled = false
	elseif part:IsA("Sound") then
		part:Stop()
		part.Playing = false
	elseif part:IsA("Highlight") then
		part.Enabled = false
	elseif part:IsA("PostProcessEffect") then
		part.Enabled = false
	elseif part:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		part.Visible = false
	end

	if part:IsA("Light") then
		config:SetAttribute("PLRange", NumberSequence.new(part.Range))
		config:SetAttribute("PLBrightness", NumberSequence.new(part.Brightness))
		config:SetAttribute("PLColor", ColorSequence.new(part.Color))
		config:SetAttribute("Shadows", part.Shadows)
		if part:IsA("SpotLight") or part:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
			config:SetAttribute("PLAngle", NumberSequence.new(part.Angle))
			config:SetAttribute("PLFace", part.Face.Name)
		end
	end
	if part:IsA("Sound") then
		config:SetAttribute("SndVolume", NumberSequence.new(part.Volume))
		config:SetAttribute("SndPlaybackSpeed", NumberSequence.new(part.PlaybackSpeed))
		config:SetAttribute("RollOffMin", part.RollOffMinDistance)
		config:SetAttribute("RollOffMax", part.RollOffMaxDistance)
		config:SetAttribute("Looped", part.Looped)
		renderTemplate.Playing = false
	end

	-- Post effects and Atmosphere: their values as one-keypoint sequences.
	if part:IsA("BlurEffect") then
		config:SetAttribute("BlurSize", NumberSequence.new(part.Size))
	elseif part:IsA("BloomEffect") then
		config:SetAttribute("BloomIntensity", NumberSequence.new(part.Intensity))
		config:SetAttribute("BloomSize", NumberSequence.new(part.Size))
		config:SetAttribute("BloomThreshold", NumberSequence.new(part.Threshold))
	elseif part:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
		config:SetAttribute("CCBrightness", NumberSequence.new(part.Brightness))
		config:SetAttribute("CCContrast", NumberSequence.new(part.Contrast))
		config:SetAttribute("CCSaturation", NumberSequence.new(part.Saturation))
		config:SetAttribute("CCTintColor", ColorSequence.new(part.TintColor))
	elseif part:IsA("Atmosphere") then
		config:SetAttribute("AtmDensity", NumberSequence.new(part.Density))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmOffset", NumberSequence.new(part.Offset))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmGlare", NumberSequence.new(part.Glare))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmHaze", NumberSequence.new(part.Haze))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmColor", ColorSequence.new(part.Color))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmDecay", ColorSequence.new(part.Decay))
	elseif part:IsA("Highlight") then
		config:SetAttribute("HLFillColor", ColorSequence.new(part.FillColor))
		config:SetAttribute("HLFillTransparency", NumberSequence.new(part.FillTransparency))
		config:SetAttribute("HLOutlineColor", ColorSequence.new(part.OutlineColor))
		config:SetAttribute("HLOutlineTransparency", NumberSequence.new(part.OutlineTransparency))
		config:SetAttribute("HLDepthMode", part.DepthMode.Name)
		-- The Adornee picker's ObjectValue; unset, the source's Adornee then its parent.
		if not part:FindFirstChild("Adornee") then
			local ad = Instance.new("ObjectValue"); ad.Name = "Adornee"; ad.Value = nil; ad.Parent = part
		end
	end

	-- The RenderTemplate must never render live.
	if renderTemplate:IsA("PostProcessEffect") then renderTemplate.Enabled = false end

	if part:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		if renderTemplate:IsA("ImageLabel") then renderTemplate.Visible = false end
		-- Only the default background goes clear; a translucent one stays.
		if part.BackgroundTransparency == 0 then
			part.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
		config:SetAttribute("Image", part.Image)
		config:SetAttribute("Position", part.Position)
		config:SetAttribute("ImgSize", part.Size)
		config:SetAttribute("AnchorPoint", part.AnchorPoint)
		config:SetAttribute("ZIndex", part.ZIndex)
		config:SetAttribute("ScaleType", part.ScaleType.Name)
		config:SetAttribute("ResampleMode", part.ResampleMode.Name)
		if not part:FindFirstChild("ImageFlipbooks") then
			local ff = Instance.new("Folder"); ff.Name = "ImageFlipbooks"; ff.Parent = part
		end
	end

	if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part:IsA("Terrain") and not isLightning and not isCameraShake and not isRocks and not isRope and not isDistortion and not isContainer and not isForce then
		if not part:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks") then
			local mf = Instance.new("Folder"); mf.Name = "MeshFlipbooks"; mf.Parent = part
		end
	end

	-- A promoted Trail: source and RenderTemplate off (each copy on), its scalar graphs and TrailLife
	-- captured from the source.
	if part:IsA("Trail") then
		part.Enabled = false
		if renderTemplate:IsA("Trail") then renderTemplate.Enabled = false end
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitBrightness", NumberSequence.new(part.Brightness))
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitLightEmission", NumberSequence.new(part.LightEmission))
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitLightInfluence", NumberSequence.new(part.LightInfluence))
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitTextureLength", NumberSequence.new(part.TextureLength))
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitMinLength", NumberSequence.new(part.MinLength))
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitMaxLength", NumberSequence.new(part.MaxLength))
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitTrailLife", NumberRange.new(part.Lifetime))
		-- The first GraphBlender state from the Trail's current Width, Transparency and Color.
		if not part:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender") then
			local gb = Instance.new("Folder"); gb.Name = "GraphBlender"
			local s1 = Instance.new("Configuration"); s1.Name = "1"
			s1:SetAttribute("Time", 0)
			s1:SetAttribute("Width", part.WidthScale or NumberSequence.new(1))
			s1:SetAttribute("Transparency", part.Transparency or NumberSequence.new(0))
			s1:SetAttribute("Color", part.Color or ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1)))
			s1:SetAttribute("_AutoTime", true)
			s1.Parent = gb; gb.Parent = part
		end
		if not part:FindFirstChild("TrailFlipbooks") then
			local tf = Instance.new("Folder"); tf.Name = "TrailFlipbooks"; tf.Parent = part
		end
	end

	if part:IsA("Beam") then
		part.Enabled = false
		part.LightInfluence = 0 -- unlit
		if renderTemplate:IsA("Beam") then renderTemplate.Enabled = false; renderTemplate.LightInfluence = 0 end

		if not part:FindFirstChild("BeamFlipbooks") then
			local bf = Instance.new("Folder"); bf.Name = "BeamFlipbooks"; bf.Parent = part
		end

		config:SetAttribute("BeamBrightness", NumberSequence.new(part.Brightness))
		config:SetAttribute("CurveSize0", NumberSequence.new(part.CurveSize0))
		config:SetAttribute("CurveSize1", NumberSequence.new(part.CurveSize1))
		config:SetAttribute("Width0", NumberSequence.new(part.Width0))
		config:SetAttribute("Width1", NumberSequence.new(part.Width1))
		config:SetAttribute("LightEmission", NumberSequence.new(part.LightEmission))
		config:SetAttribute("BeamLightInfluence", NumberSequence.new(0))
		config:SetAttribute("Segments", NumberSequence.new(part.Segments))
		config:SetAttribute("TextureLength", NumberSequence.new(part.TextureLength))
		config:SetAttribute("TextureSpeed", NumberSequence.new(part.TextureSpeed))
		config:SetAttribute("FaceCamera", part.FaceCamera)
		config:SetAttribute("ZOffset", part.ZOffset)
		config:SetAttribute("BeamTextureMode", part.TextureMode.Name)

		-- _AutoTime: a state's Time set by Add State, not by hand.
		local gb = Instance.new("Folder"); gb.Name = "GraphBlender"
		local s1 = Instance.new("Configuration"); s1.Name = "1"
		s1:SetAttribute("Time", 0); s1:SetAttribute("Transparency", part.Transparency); s1:SetAttribute("Color", part.Color)
		s1:SetAttribute("_AutoTime", true)
		s1.Parent = gb; gb.Parent = part
	end

	if not part:FindFirstChild("EmitParent") then
		local ep = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		ep.Name = "EmitParent"
		ep.Value = nil
		ep.Parent = part
	end

	if (part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Attachment")) and not isCameraShake and not isRocks and not isRope and not isDistortion and not isContainer and not part:FindFirstChild("Link") then
		local lk = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		lk.Name = "Link"
		lk.Parent = part
	end

	if (part:IsA("BasePart") or isForce) and not isLightning and not isCameraShake and not isRocks and not isRope and not isDistortion and not isContainer and not part:FindFirstChild("AccelTarget") then
		local at = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		at.Name = "AccelTarget"
		at.Value = nil
		at.Parent = part
	end

	-- ShapePart: with UseShape, particles spawn in its volume. The source by default, so the picker
	-- shows it; Lightning uses it for the bolt's start.
	if part:IsA("BasePart") and not isCameraShake and not isRocks and not isRope and not isDistortion and not isContainer and not isForce and not part:FindFirstChild("ShapePart") then
		local sp = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		sp.Name = "ShapePart"
		sp.Value = part
		sp.Parent = part
	end

	-- Lightning's Point endpoint and Rope's end anchor.
	if (isLightning or isRope) and not part:FindFirstChild("Target") then
		local tv = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		tv.Name = "Target"
		tv.Value = nil
		tv.Parent = part
	end

	part:SetAttribute("Transformed", true)
	part:SetAttribute("Qwinkle", true)
	-- One id per authored emitter, inherited by copies: the even spread's shared counter.
	part:SetAttribute("_EvenCycleId", game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false))
	-- One emission per Emit (as Migrate and TransformModel).
	part:SetAttribute("EmitCount", 1)
	part:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", 0)
	part:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", 0)
	part:SetAttribute("IsEmitter", true)
	if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Beam") or part:IsA("Trail") or part:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		part:SetAttribute("PreloadTexture", false)
	end
	-- Atmosphere is one per Lighting: Animate by default.
	part:SetAttribute("EmissionMode", part:IsA("Atmosphere") and "Animate" or "Emit")
	part:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", false)
	-- Link-driven types only.
	if not isContainer and ((part:IsA("BasePart") and not isCameraShake and not isRocks and not isRope and not isDistortion) or part:IsA("Beam") or part:IsA("Attachment") or part:IsA("Model")) then
		part:SetAttribute("LinkMode", "Follow")
		part:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "None")
	end
	pcall(function() Particle.TransformCompleted:Fire(part) end)
end


-- A Model's own children move into the RenderTemplate (Motor6Ds and controllers intact).
function Particle:TransformModel(model, typeDef)
	if model:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
	DragModel.mark(TypeRegistry.createConfig(model, typeDef))

	-- The pivot first: the Model gives up its PrimaryPart below, and its origin must not follow the
	-- RenderTemplate when Animate moves it.
	local pivot = model:GetPivot()
	local primaryPart = model.PrimaryPart
	local contents = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if not MODEL_INTERNALS[child.Name] then table.insert(contents, child) end
	end

	-- Cloned empty, keeping the Model's properties and scale.
	local renderTemplate = cloneWithout(model, contents)
	renderTemplate.Name = "RenderTemplate"
	for _, child in renderTemplate:GetChildren() do
		child:Destroy()
	end
	for _, attrName in ipairs({"Transformed", "Qwinkle", "IsEmitter", "EmitCount", "EmitDuration", "EmitDelay", "EmissionMode", "AnimateLoop"}) do
		renderTemplate:SetAttribute(attrName, nil)
	end

	-- PrimaryPart cleared before the children move, so an undo sets it again once they are back.
	model.PrimaryPart = nil
	-- In the place before the children move in.
	renderTemplate.Parent = model
	for _, child in ipairs(contents) do
		child.Parent = renderTemplate
	end
	renderTemplate.PrimaryPart = primaryPart
	renderTemplate.WorldPivot = pivot
	model.WorldPivot = pivot

	-- Parts anchored, native emitters off; the parts stay clickable.
	for _, desc in renderTemplate:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			desc.Anchored = true; desc.CanCollide = false; desc.CanQuery = false
			desc.CanTouch = false; desc.CastShadow = false; desc.Massless = true
		elseif (desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail"))
			and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed")
		then
			desc.Enabled = false
		end
	end

	if not model:FindFirstChild("EmitParent") then
		local ep = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		ep.Name = "EmitParent"
		ep.Value = nil
		ep.Parent = model
	end

	if not model:FindFirstChild("Link") then
		local lk = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		lk.Name = "Link"
		lk.Parent = model
	end

	model:SetAttribute("Transformed", true)
	model:SetAttribute("Qwinkle", true)
	model:SetAttribute("EmitCount", 1)
	model:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", 0)
	model:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", 0)
	model:SetAttribute("IsEmitter", true)
	model:SetAttribute("PreloadTexture", false)
	model:SetAttribute("EmissionMode", "Emit")
	model:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", false)
	model:SetAttribute("LinkMode", "Follow")
	model:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "None")
	pcall(function() Particle.TransformCompleted:Fire(model) end)
end

end

--[[
	Turbulence  -  Perlin-noise wander shared by Part / Attachment / Model / Lightning.
	Absolute offset at normalized life i:
	  turb(i) = amp(i) * (noise(t, seed, K0), noise(t, seed, K1), noise(t, seed, K2))
	with t = i * LifeTime * TurbulenceFrequency. Deterministic in i, so reverse Timescale and the
	InvertMotion pre-sim replay the same wander path. Consumers integrate a telescoping delta
	against pData._prevTurbOff, separate from _prevWorldOff because OnHit Bounce mirrors
	re-baseline only the PosOffset accumulator (EventsCollision.luau); noise is statistically
	symmetric so it never mirrors.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)

-- Non-integer axis decorrelation offsets (math.noise returns 0 on the integer lattice).
local K0, K1, K2 = 0.17, 137.7, 291.3

local Turbulence = {}

-- Flat-zero envelopes (the writeDefaults stamp) count as "no turbulence", so idle emitters
-- skip the per-frame noise work.
function Turbulence.isLive(seq)
	if not seq then return nil end
	if GraphMod.IsStatic(seq) and GraphMod.GetStaticValue(seq, 0) == 0 then return nil end
	return seq
end

-- Absolute pre-DisplacementMode offset at normalized life i.
function Turbulence.sampleRaw(ampGraph, ampSeed, turbSeed, freq, lifeTime, i)
	local amp = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(i, ampGraph, ampSeed)
	if amp == 0 then return Vector3.zero end
	local t = i * lifeTime * freq
	return Vector3.new(
		amp * math.noise(t, turbSeed, K0),
		amp * math.noise(t, turbSeed, K1),
		amp * math.noise(t, turbSeed, K2))
end

-- Resolves the absolute offset at i into the DisplacementMode frame (no mirror args).
local function resolvedAt(pData, i)
	return Constants.resolveDisplacement(
		Turbulence.sampleRaw(pData.Graphs.Turbulence, pData.Seeds.Turbulence,
			pData._turbSeed, pData.TurbulenceFrequency, pData.LifeTime, i),
		pData.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation)
end

-- World-space frame delta vs the previous sample (telescoping vs _prevTurbOff).
function Turbulence.frameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	local worldOff = resolvedAt(pData, steppedI)
	local delta = worldOff - pData._prevTurbOff
	pData._prevTurbOff = worldOff
	return delta
end

-- Stamps graph/seed/flags onto a fresh pData and primes the accumulator at turb(0) WITHOUT
-- shifting the spawn pose: wander is relative to the spawn point. Must run AFTER
-- SpawnRotation / SpawnEmitterRotation / LifeTime are set on pData.
function Turbulence.buildInto(pData, data)
	local seq = Turbulence.isLive(data.Turbulence)
	pData.HasTurbulence = seq ~= nil
	if not seq then
				-- AnimateLoop replay re-runs this: clears a prior cycle's graph if Turbulence went flat 0 mid-loop.
		pData.Graphs.Turbulence = nil
		return
	end
	pData.Graphs.Turbulence = seq
		-- Reuses the seeds the InvertMotion pre-sim rolled (Transform.luau PreSimulateForward) so live replay matches.
	pData.Seeds.Turbulence = pData.Seeds.Turbulence or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(seq)
	pData.TurbulenceFrequency = data.TurbulenceFrequency or 1
	pData._turbSeed = pData.Seeds._turbSeed or (math.random() * 997 + 0.5)
	pData._prevTurbOff = resolvedAt(pData, 0)
end

-- Re-primes at AnimateLoop cycle restart (same seed, so each cycle replays the same wander).
function Turbulence.reprime(pData)
	if not pData.HasTurbulence then return end
	pData._prevTurbOff = resolvedAt(pData, 0)
end

return Turbulence
